items.name: Immortal Garudania

items.description: Garudania's cycle reminds you of your own story. Having started from nothing, you've managed to grow and shine with what you've achieved. Once this whole blaze of glory has consumed you, you too can start afresh. That is the path of an adventurer.
items.name: Conquering Garudania

items.description: Garudania's wrath is imprisoned inside this headgear. If you can't control it, it could erupt at any moment.
items.name: Garudania Eruption

items.description: Everywhere you go, this cape burns every living thing. You won't need to iron it; it's surely hot enough already. In fact, if you put your iron on it, the iron will start melting.
items.name: Garudania Flow

items.description: Don't trust that cute little bluish face – Shushus are usually bloodthirsty, terrifying and cruel. So it's probably a bad idea to snuggle up to this pet for comfort on those long winter nights. It's impossible to say which body part you'll lose if you do.
items.name: Sapphire Tibilax

items.description: This shield was forged with ore residue from cooled lava. This unique alloy makes it unyieldingly solid and extremely resistant to fire. It's great for barbecues.
items.name: Garudania Slag

items.description: The sharp talons of Garudania are usually used to tear apart prey. When they're on your feet, however, they seem nowhere near as dangerous and keep you nice and stable.
items.name: Garudania Talons

items.description: You can't really measure the energy produced by a Tiwabbit Wosungwee. But one thing is certain: thanks to it, your roarped will be faster than anything you've ever seen. You could try replacing it with another creature, but it probably wouldn't work as well.
items.name: Incandescent Roarped

items.description: You can't really measure the energy produced by a Tiwabbit Wosungwee. But one thing is certain: thanks to it, your roarped will be faster than anything you've ever seen. You could try replacing it with another creature, but it probably wouldn't work as well.
items.name: Aerial Roarped

items.description: You can't really measure the energy produced by a Tiwabbit Wosungwee. But one thing is certain: thanks to it, your roarped will be faster than anything you've ever seen. You could try replacing it with another creature, but it probably wouldn't work as well.
items.name: Seismic Roarped

items.description: You can't really measure the energy produced by a Tiwabbit Wosungwee. But one thing is certain: thanks to it, your roarped will be faster than anything you've ever seen. You could try replacing it with another creature, but it probably wouldn't work as well.
items.name: Amphibian Roarped

items.description: When you wear this bandana, you are often mistaken for a member of the famous Gang of Sharcackles But actually, you decided to put it around your head merely for style reasons. Either that, or because you let an adventurer you met at the Astrub zaap take a clump of the hair from your head.
items.name: Bandanimal

items.description: Nothing can stop you, and your bag proves it. It's made from the remains of a huge fish that you ate. This bone stitched onto your bag will frighten any Seal-Wolves you cross paths with.
items.name: Penglamour Fishbag

items.description: You rarely see sunhats on the ice floe, but when you think about it, what could be more ridiculous than getting sunstroke while skiing?
items.name: Penglamour Sunhat

items.description: If everything is going downhill, someone has stolen your bike, and it's too much for you to take, then don't forget to hold on to your life ring, because it will always be there to save you.
items.name: Penglamour Life Ring

items.description: Are you fiery-tempered and headstrong? This hat's for you. It's perfect for protecting yourself from blows in a fight, but also from the sun while hunting for turtles at the beach.
items.name: Slamshell Carapanama

items.description: Your inner adventurer's enthusiasm can't be contained. So, you've decided to embrace this elation with this bag, which is giving off heat that seems ready to consume your enemies.
items.name: Slamshell Flambag

items.description: This 100% natural shield is made of thick scales that make especially strong. This carapace is used to protecting its guests from beasts that would like to eat them, so it will do the same for you. Nature will always protect its own kind.
items.name: Slamshell Escaletcheon

items.description: Some people see ivory as a sign of wealth. In your eyes, it's just a sign of barbaric acts committed by nutjobs. So, you decided to hunt the hunters, making a set with what was left of their loot in the process. This cape is the jewel in its crown, and it opens the doors of your prey's world.
items.name: Jitterscar Tail

items.description: Having horns on your head is never a good sign. Potential admirers might wonder what they'd be getting into when they see you wearing them. But if you've chosen the single life, wear this two-horned hat with pride and go for it!
items.name: Jitterscar Two-Horned Hat

items.description: These claws are as sharp as they are bloody. Many people will say they're afraid just looking at them, especially at night. So if you're wearing them and you don't want to scare anyone, consider pairing them with a cute little accessory to make yourself look less frightening.
items.name: Jitterscar Claws

items.description: This bag is decorated with rare feathers that were taken from an abandoned Vulturricane nest. Wearing it on your back makes it look like you can fly, so be careful not to take off when there's a strong gust.
items.name: Vulturricane Featherbag

items.description: Your haircut isn't bad – it's got its own style, and if anyone ruffles your feathers by telling you otherwise, you're ready to fly at them. And if they criticise you anyway, it means they won't mind getting their feathers burnt. They must be a complete feather-brain.
items.name: Vulturricane Crest

items.description: Whoever would want a shield made out of feathers? That's what your enemies must be thinking, but they'll be surprised to discover the truth. The elasticity and lightness of the feathers forming the shield make it resistant to piercing and really easy to handle.
items.name: Vulturricane Feathescutcheon

items.description: You can't really measure the energy produced by a Tiwabbit Wosungwee. But one thing is certain: thanks to it, your roarped will be faster than anything you've ever seen. You could try replacing it with another creature, but it probably wouldn't work as well.
items.name: Tweecher's Roarped

items.description: They said you'd have to be off your Helnut to go on an adventure like this, so you went and bought one.
items.name: Team Croquette Helnut

items.description: Did you choose water, or did water choose you? With this element by your side, you are ready to face this new adventure.
items.name: Penglamour Ring

items.description: Did you choose fire, or did fire choose you? With this element by your side, you are ready to face this new adventure.
items.name: Slamshell Ring

items.description: Did you choose earth, or did earth choose you? With this element by your side, you are ready to face this new adventure.
items.name: Jitterscar Ring

items.description: Did you choose air, or did air choose you? With this element by your side, you are ready to face this new adventure.
items.name: Vulturricane Ring

items.description: Fame has always called to you so when you were offered a chance at a brush with fame, you didn't hesitate for a second. Maybe you should have brushed your hair first before chasing fame in this cap, though.
items.name: Visornary Cap

items.description: Your devotion earned you this helmet. It'll protect your ears well enough, hasn't been approved for use as protective gear while riding a roarped.
items.name: Tweecher Helmet

items.description: You were out hunting for the perfect helmet the other day when a strange fellow let out an even stranger cry: "Uwu!!" Before he could say "one, two", you calmed that lout down and stole his stranger-than-strange head covering.
items.name: Confident Tweecher Helmet

items.description: As if out of a different era, this cape seems to broadcast an enchanting melody: Poh-Lom Pim Boom Laaaaa, Pi-Li-Li-Laaam. Passers-by all stare at you. For some, the tune seems familiar but no one can figure out where they've heard it before...
items.name: Tweecher Cape

items.description: They say that mirrors are reflections leading to another world. This shield seems to be one and if you break it, you'll have seven years of bad luck. The person who made it claims that it's an improved version of an ancient shield whose rarity is rivalled only by its ugliness.
items.name: Tweecher Shield

items.description: This strange magical mechanism will be your greatest ally when trying to survive a heat wave. It produces irresistible festive sounds that can force any Twelvian to do the shimmy and keep your beverages cold.
items.name: Refrigeradio

items.description: Still can't decide between a good tehlaytubiez corktail and the more scandalous realetytivi corktail? Thanks to this headgear's inimitable style, you won't have to choose between the two. As an added bonus, it'll keep your ears cool in fine weather.
items.name: Kopakabacap

items.description: This cape is made out of strips of cloth that will wiggle and wave to the beat of your summer tunes. Make music or be stylish? Why choose when you can do both?
items.name: Kapeukulele

items.description: Ok, fine. It's true that you won't be able to stop a dragon's breath with these bracelets... But shields are heavy, cumbersome and make your arms sweat on sunny days... Clearly, these bracelets are the right choice!
items.name: Summerbracelet

items.description: Legend has it that this legendary animal is the reincarnation of a goddess with the power to bring her paintings to life. All the same, there's no use asking her to paint kamas to make you rich: all you'd see is flowers blossoming in a riot of colours.
items.name: Kamiwolf

items.description: When the wind whistles in your ears, listen carefully to the sweet melody sung by the rustling leaves. What do you hear? Whispers of jealousy or the charming laughter of a doll?
items.name: Leafy Crown

items.description: With this veil draped over your shoulders, you might be able to slip unnoticed into the forest or amid the branches of the Tree Koholo. Or perhaps a small greenish creature will spot you and tumble head over heals for your charms...
items.name: Leafy Veil

items.description: How many times has your heart been broken? And how many times have you broken someone's heart? Wounds like these can forge both your character and a true protective shell – a real shield.
items.name: Doll Heart

items.description: This crown steeped in a more or less glorious past should be worn with caution and moderation. It is strongly recommended that you remove it at the slightest sign of a dark thought or bad mood for your own good – and that of your loved ones and even your enemies.
items.name: Grimacing King's Crown

items.description: This cape is perfectly fitted out to make your enemies as mad as its former owner.
items.name: Grimacing King's Cape

items.description: Leorictus was a king who loved ruling, fighting and feasting, but what he loved most of all was... his dear mum's wince meat pies.
items.name: Grimacing King's Shoulder Pad

items.description: Slowly but surely.
items.name: Cire Momore Armour

items.description:
"14 Jullier –
Moskitos also
Celebrate.
Fireworks –
The hiss of a kiss,
Cries of joy.
Shows' end –
In the sky,
Beautiful stars."

— "14 Jullier", Amaknian poem
items.name: Hecate's Malicious Horns

items.description:
Hecate the Hoaxer, Guardian of Jullier, is a shadow demon. A formidable moskito killer (and loving collector of moskito proboscises), she is also a master in the art of camouflage. Indeed, her powers of metamorphosis let her take on any appearance... which, for many, is a huge part of her appeal.

Sometimes, she even spies on those around her, hidden in the branches of a tree or at the entrance of a cave. She forms alliances with whomever she feels like, whenever she feels like it.
items.name: Hecate's Metamorphosis

items.description:
Seemingly cold and standoffish at first (she is a demon after all!), Hecate burns with the heat of a thousand smouldering coals whenever Ulgrude appears at her side. This passion is, by the way, what fuels the most torrid days of summer when the atmosphere itself seems to sweat...

Her secret love for the young Protector of Martalo can drive her to the craziest of acts. When he was injured in a fight with Djaul, Hecate went so far as to steal the "Moon Pearl" from Sumens to save him. To slip past his guard, she took on the appearance of his friend, Silouate, and knocked him out with a few knock-out drops. With the precious artefact in her possession, she was able to cure Ulgrude without anyone catching on to her tricks. Sadly, though, she has never quite managed to hide the suspicious smell that the Pearl left on her fingers...
items.name: Hecate's Secret Love

items.description: Just like its mistress Hecate, this spirit is a ferocious moskito hunter. Don't be fooled by its evil appearance: it's a true blessing for campers because it can gobble down up to 2,000 in a single night. Moskitos, that is, not campers!
items.name: Jullier Spirit

items.description: Dragoones of this colour have recently appeared in nature but no one really knows why. The most popular theory says that several wild red dragoones fell into a deep chasm where they remained trapped for several generations, unable to find a way out. They spent many years feeding mainly on the veins of cobalt found on the walls of the chasm, which eventually gave them this gentle azure colour. Then, finally, one of them managed to find a way out.
items.name: Blue Dragoone

items.description: Born of several generations of careful inbreeding, this dragoone elegantly displays the colours of a famous figure. What the salesman didn't tell you is that its life expectancy is much shorter than its slightly less inbred peers.
items.name: Adamai Dragoone

items.description: Your aim will always be true when parrying blows with this shield.
items.name: Vanelle Sings Shield

items.description: When life gives Pouchecot – also known as "the Fruitcake" – lemons, he'd rather make lemonade than upset the apple cart. Even when things go pear-shaped, making the gods smile is his idea of a plumb job. He doesn't give a fig about sour grapes, and when it's time to joke around, he's the top banana.
items.name: Pouchecot's Toopish

items.description:
When it's time for the grape harvest, Pouchecot – whose guiding principle is to never take on too much work – suddenly finds himself drowning in the amount of work he must get done in only a few weeks.

Still, he completes this monumental task every year to the great delight of all grape growers and wine lovers in the World of Twelve and then drops out of sight for several months to recover from this exhausting tradition.

Don't try to contact the Fruitcake during his rest for any reason. Let him rest and enjoy a well-deserved glass of wine, hidden away in one of his homes the location of which he's been careful to never reveal to anyone.
items.name: Pouchecot's Plenitude

items.description:
"The lethargy of days basking

Under Frauguctor's sunny rays

Confound the mortal-born

When on the trees treasure is borne

The vermilion fruit of such calibre

Is the favourite among travellers

Who enjoy the sweet juice

As they travel, footloose."

— "Frauguctor", Amaknian poem
items.name: Pouchecot's Serenity

items.description: This little albino jester does his best to amuse everyone. With dirty dad joke after dirty dad joke, he'll have your friends who like that sort of thing in stitches. You probably wouldn't want to bring him along on a date, though – one of his gags might offend your beloved.
items.name: Frauguctor Spirit

items.description: This dragoturkey is perfect for playing tricks at night. With its dark coat, it'll melt into the night leaving only its glowing eyes visible. With a bit of care, it'll seem like ghosts are walking about.
items.name: Neutro Dragoturkey

items.description: When you wear this cape, it's quite possible that charming little birds land on your shoulders.
items.name: Botanic Panache Cape

items.description: Adorn yourself with this cape and your back pains will be a distant – albeit painful – memory. You'll be able to move about lithely without feeling like you're carrying the weight of the World of Twelve on your shoulders.
items.name: Volatile Panache Cape

items.description: Wearing this cape is a bit like having one's own little waterskin full of water with you at all times. Thanks to it, you'll never be thirsty – not even if you get lost in the middle of Ohwymi Desert.
items.name: Aqueous Panache Cape

items.description: If you're the first to reach for a jumper as soon as the temperature drops a bit, reach for this cape. Its comforting warmth will keep you toasty and warm. Obviously, you shouldn't wear it during a heatwave or you'll feel like you're caught in a burning oven.
items.name: Fiery Panache Cape

items.description: If you, like the Protector of Septangel, rejoice in feeling bad, these shoulder pads are just perfect! Nothing could be harder or less cosy so they'll stop just about everyone from crying on your shoulder. All you'll need to do is twist the knife – metaphorically, of course – to appreciate a shared moment of gloom.
items.name: Ravalesque Shoulder Pads

items.description: Setting the skull of a centoror into a shield isn't nearly enough to give you the power to command spectres. It would take a lot more to truly follow in the footsteps of the Protector of Septangel. Points for effort, though.
items.name: Ravalesque Forgery

items.description: The months slip by, each different from the last. Say goodbye to simple, festive evenings by the fire. The sun is rising later, leaves are turning brown, and the rain is wetting the dry ground. There's no mistaking the signs – Raval is working hard to usher in autumn.
items.name: Ravalesque Equinox

items.description: In addition to making you look like a wounded animal – and perfectly complementing your sour mood – this eye patch makes it easy to avoid the gaze of any Bworkettes who cross your path. You can trust Ravel when he says this protection isn't just window dressing – sometimes NOT catching someone's eye is the least embarrassing option.
items.name: Ravalesque Eye Patch

items.description: If you've always dreamed of straddling death and riding off into the sunset, this creature – revived by the power of Ravel – will exceed your wildest expectations. Of course, it isn't death itself you'll be riding – obviously, the queen of Externam has better things to do.
items.name: Septangel Spirit

items.description: Like that feather floating on the breeze, the melodies that accompany your tales flutter into the ears of the onlookers who care to listen. That very same feather leads you on the adventures you experience in the form of lovely ballads.
items.name: Bard's Hat

items.description: This cape is adorned with a magnificent instrument, one that will let you play the most beautiful harmonies at any time. You can also use it to cut butter – but only sweet butter, please.
items.name: Bard's Lyre Cloak

items.description: The artisan who created this piece – the crowing glory of his life's work – refined every tiny detail until his last breath. If one day you are running out of steam, use your last breath to blow into this instrument. It'll produce notes that take your breath away.
items.name: Bard's Woodwind Shield

items.description: Tiring of being blinded by his own attacks, Lumino asked his stylist to make him a pair of tinted glasses. Too bad he's always leaving them behind...
items.name: Luminoears

items.description: This cape in the Multimen leader's colours is a must-have accessory for all Lumino fans worthy of the name!
items.name: Luminocape

items.description: Some of the crime-fighting minifoux's fans just love making costumes that look just like him to be just as cool as he is! Someone really should tell them that Lumino has never used a shield in combat, though.
items.name: Luminoshield

items.description: This combat lizard used to belong to the leader of a group of bandits. They say that, despite his kind heart, the bandit withered away to a dry, grey husk because of his hatred and thirst for vengeance.
items.name: Geckomodo

items.description: The famous Katar was already an exceptional warrior before becoming the bloodthirsty killer we know today. What is less well known is that he was a rather good sailor and had a sense of humour (such as it was): his boat was made up of one large sail and two parallel hulls. He baptised it the "Katar Marine".
items.name: Katar Sail

items.description: Whenever the urge to fight and jump fist-first into exploring new places would hit, Katar would hop on his boat and sail off in search of opponents worth fighting. He nicknamed these trips his "A Scarf Abroad" adventures.
items.name: Katar Scarf

items.description:
This trusty old cap won't make those who used to wear it proudly in the days before Fallanster dissolved the mercenary clans of Astrub young again.
It may have lost its ability to take on any role, but it is still just as superb.
items.name: Clint

items.description:
Legend has it that a fervent disciple of Iop used to own the sword on the back of this cape. He's also rumoured to be one of the first mercenaries in the World of Twelve. But not just any mercenary: under the direct authority of Iop, the sharpness of his blade and the strength of his arms laid down the law in the service of the gods.

They say his name was Serian-Kerm, and that he founded the mercenary clan of the same name that wrote its name all over the history of the World of Twelve.
items.name: The Kapwet

items.description:
The World of Twelve marches forward, generation after generation, but some vows resist all of Xelor's tests.

"Selenyte you are and Selenyte you shall remain.
In all circumstances, fair and loyal to your clan you shall be.
Respect shall you give to all, but pity for your opponent you shall have none.
Your promises you shall keep.
Your clan's honour you shall safeguard with your life.
A weapon in defence of your peers you shall be.
Neither your strength nor your power shall you abuse.
Allegiance to the Mercenary code of honour you shall swear.
Intrepid, your hands you shall sully, but your thoughts shall remain pure.
Swift and efficient, you shall always complete your mission or delegate it."

- Second Version of the Selenyte Clan's Code of Honour
items.name: Serviss-the-Free Aegis

items.description:
Some mercenaries stick to a contract's clauses to the letter and will take on any job if the client pays... Some, however, don't see things the same way. Some enjoy a hard job done well, with effort; others are ready to throw themselves body and soul into their mission no matter what the cost or the consequences, even if it means losing their lives.

Mercenaries are our brothers and Riem is our name. Protect the former, honour the latter.
A job begun is a job fully done. Success is the source of our pride.
No job's bell will toll for us. Thus we never fail in our duty to rest.
We wear Nedora's name with dignity. It shines on our acts and exploits.
If our services provide only profits, then the client must pay full price.
Making life better is worth every effort. Body and soul we devote to that cause.

- Hippocrusty Oath
items.name: Nedora Elytrons

items.description: A bit looni around the edges, this small, loyal bow wow loves to tarry over fine feasts and life's little pleasures. As an added bonus, it has great flair for sniffing out juicy contracts.
items.name: Foxy-Tarryer

items.description: There's nothing worse than having your hair flop over your eyes when you go to deliver the fatal blow. Any self-respecting assassin therefore needs their hair do to be on point. This elastic headband was designed with just that in mind – you're sure to love it.
items.name: Tokagecko Headband

items.description: You've always thought that wearing a cape at work is a bad idea. Such an ample and impractical piece of clothing would only make it easier for your targets to spot you. Your pragmatic side therefore pushed you to add this katana holster to your wardrobe so you could move quickly once you sheathed your weapon.
items.name: Tokagecko Katana Holster

items.description: Wiley finisher that you are, this shield will let you eliminate your opponents before they can even begin to understand what's happened. Indeed, it has a hidden blade and an ingenious mechanism that slides the blade out to counterattack after blocking a blow.
items.name: Tokagecko Secret Blade

items.description: An assassin's footsteps are light and silent. You'll be like a lizard after its prey and your opponents will never hear you coming.
items.name: Tokagecko Ring

items.description:
"Dare to see the primitive
Under a gusting North wind
That sweeps away all logic
 
Enjoy the therapy of
The great Wilderness
Follow a line of traps
Along the axis of truth
 
Fully in my time
Neither before nor after
I am here for the life
That beats in the bushes"

- Nozual Salokin
items.name: Trapper Headgear

items.description:
Over the hills came a trapper man
Sack on back, wild pelts in his hand
Old dusty furs, pebbles 'bedded in the land stand and stare
Nice as you please comes the trapper man
Drinking bamboo milk, bottle in his hand
Speaking to no one in particular but happily

Down where the piwis dance kaliptus wood drying for the fire
Yellow beak and sleek now the tofu are crying flying higher
Out from the treechnid came a little black saltik
Taking the Sun the morning being very thick
Old dusty furs, pebbles 'bedded in the sand stand and stare
The Trapper and the saltik
The Trapper and the saltik 
The Trapper and the saltik 

- Don O'Van, retired crooner
items.name: Trapper Cape

items.description: The woolly piggoth horns that adorn this shield are very useful for trappers – just perfect for knocking out their prey without damaging the pelts.
items.name: Trapper Shield

items.description: If you don't want to sneeze into a bush and scare your prey, we highly recommend this scarf.
items.name: Trapper Scarf

items.description: Make sure you don't let your dragoturkey get too close to your woolly piggoth steak – this harness tends to give dragoturkeys a rather, ahem, carnivorous appetite.
items.name: Trapper Dragoturkey

items.description: The perfect harness for those who love to hunt and fish.
items.name: Trapper Seemyool

items.description: Rhineetle-riding trappers just love this technique: fly discreetly over their prey and then drop down on them very suddenly. And what is the technique called, you may ask? The downward rhibound clothesline, of course.
items.name: Trapper Rhineetle

items.description: All good trappers know how to track their prey. This ring lets you leave tracks of your own so you can better ambush anyone who'd dare track you.
items.name: Trapper Ring

items.description: During your many adventures, you once crossed paths with a bard who sang a few of his best tunes for you. The song he wrote in honour of his petsmount was your favourite. You still can't get the song out of your head, either. It talked about flying on the wings of love to touch the stars... There's probably a hidden meaning there that went over your head.
items.name: Bard's Falcodove

items.description: If nature has taught us anything, it's that you can never judge a creature by its size. Even the smallest critter can be very dangerous, as this Geckymosis proves. One belly rub too many and you can say goodbye to your hand, so be careful if you adopt this one.
items.name: Geckymosis

items.description: Spirits rarely take physical form in the shape of a stone snake. And yet, stone is a simple, stable material, just like its protector. In this form, however, it embodies all the suppressed violence that lets Maimane be the calm hero he seems to be.
items.name: Octolliard Spirit

items.description:
"When the soul seeks stability,

And the tired heart yearns for quietude,

The hero earns a newfound receptivity,

And in the love of family finds gratitude."

— "Octolliard", a hero's epithet
items.name: Maimane Armband

items.description: Ever since you decided to let your hair grow out, you've seen a shift in how people look at you. Apparently, this type of hairdo is unconsciously viewed as a sign of strength and good health. Having such panache for once is not unpleasant – but truth be told, all you did was lose your scissors.
items.name: Maimane's Locks

items.description: This cape adorned with gold represents, like its wearer, the perfect balance of confidence and distrust. Poise is not the same as arrogance and provides stability. However, it can be misinterpreted by some, so stay on your guard.
items.name: Maimane's Poise

items.description: This artefact was used to send adventurers to unknown lands. Each exploration would take these adventurers further and further and, whenever they ended up in front of a gate, they couldn't help but think: "Oh, just one more!"
items.name: Zaapshield

items.description: If you need a hand getting a handle on life, then Cire's Hand is the steady hand you want helping you along. If danger knocks at your door, gather your courage in both hands and let fly with a heavy hand. Ultimately, no need to be a dab hand, and if you don't force its hand, it'll be putty in your hands.
items.name: Cire's Hand

items.description: The Buboulder isn't overweight – it's simply storing a little fat to get through winter. Because some Amaknians will hang them on their Kwismas itztings as a tradition. Luckily, the bugs and arachnees that wander into your home will be more than enough to keep it fed. Convenient and ornamental.
items.name: Buboulder

items.description: A true chimera, built from scratch by Djaul the Flounderer himself, this creature leaves calamity in its wake. Like a scourge, you'll be feared by all, which seems to suit you perfectly.
items.name: Descendre Spirit

items.description:
"Novamaire fills the World of Twelve with an immanent force. The elements intertwine, nothing conflicts, Terrdala becomes muddy, Airdala's sky falls in, Otomai's trees blaze, Amakna's bell towers hide behind mist, outlines fade, and things tangle, sensually, overwhelmed by the Obscurati."

— Brumaire the Dark Bleeder
items.name: Novamaire Spirit

items.description:
"Sweet sunshine of golden rays,
Brightening up the chamber,
Shore where sorrows fade away,
Orchards dyed with amber,
Lake so pure with yachts asail,
Jovial mountains, flowery trails,
Farewell! 'Tis Novamaire."

— "Novamaire", Amaknian poem
items.name: Brumaire's Rays

items.description:
Most coats are woven to keep the body warm as winter nears. Brumaire's coat is different. When you put it on, you will feel extremely cold, and it will chill you to the bone. Your shoulders will slump under the weight of regret, the encroaching darkness and the days gone by. Why should you put up with the overwhelming heat of life? Your hands will be covered with frost. Your lips will embrace silence. A layer of ice will weigh down your eyelids, as if to encourage you to close your eyes right now.
Then the sound of a laughing child will wake you from your daydream, and you will have a burning desire to eat strawberry sorbet.
items.name: Brumaire's Coat

items.description:
"Three crowns for the Thwee Kings under the snow,
Seven for the Stubbyobs in their forges of stone,
Twelve for disciples loyal to the immortal powers,
One for the Dark Bleeder on his icy throne,
In the time of Novamaire where the mists lie,
One crown to cool them all, one crown to numb them,
One crown to petrify them all and in the starkness freeze them,
In the time of Novamaire where the mists lie."

— Inscriptions engraved in the golden winter sunlight
items.name: Brumaire's Crown

items.description: To many, Djaul's horns represent his wickedness – but others say they are actually tied to his frivolity. It's even said that Djaul used his sorcery to try and seduce a goddess. The goddess, having unmasked him, apparently said: "No, Djaul, Djaul. I'm not your harlot, Djaul, Djaul."
items.name: Djaul's Horns

items.description: These wings symbolise the relative freedom Rushu granted to Djaul. When survival of the fittest is the name of the game, are you really free? This will only fuel the Great Flounderer's resentment, who is determined to calm his nerves by terrorising the World of Twelve.
items.name: Djaul's Wings

items.description:
O sorrow! O destruction! O darkness of my soul!
Have I so lost myself, surrounded by flames?
And in my life did I not hope to break
Only to fill my heart, abandoned by all?
This evil, consuming me and dreaded by everyone,
This evil, its darkness devouring the Shustuft Crust,
Has so often guided me, against gods and goddesses,
Was it but an echo of my own sadness?

— "Descendre's Despair", a shushu poem
items.name: Djaul's Skull

items.description: The sweetest knight in the City of Mercenaries! Along with a full set of armour, this Paladur comes to you armed with a sword and ready to brawl. If it asks you to stop, don't be fooled by its size. Looks can be deceiving, and you'll be surprised to know – the Paladur is from Astrub, so it knows how to fight.
items.name: Paladur

items.description: This Croum will always hold a torch for you, which becomes problematic when this clingy pet tries to nuzzle you. No matter what you're doing, or what mood you're in, when it decides to get close to you, it'll warm your heart – and probably the rest of you.
items.name: Cire's Waxy Croum

items.description: This Rusty Croum has been forgotten for a long time. Maybe its previous owner lost their life in some dreadful dungeon. Or maybe it was just abandoned by an unscrupulous adventurer who ditched it to go on holiday. But regardless of its past, you've decided to give it a second shot at life filled with love and high adventure.
items.name: Cire's Rusty Croum

items.description: This Neutro always has its head in the clouds and goes whichever way the wind blows. It's a loyal pet, but you'll have to constantly keep an eye on it unless you want to lose it.
items.name: Airy Neutro

items.description: This Neutro takes to combat like a fish to water, so feel free to bring it with you into every dungeon you explore. And if it does a good job, be sure to reward it with a few grawns. They're its favourite snack!
items.name: Watery Neutro

items.description: This Neutro has a temper that can flare up when you least expect it! It's a hot-blooded pet that may take time to learn to handle. But if you're patient and take the time to fuel its better instincts, it will prove a valuable ally for your adventures.
items.name: Fiery Neutro

items.description: This Neutro will follow you wherever you grow. Whether your career as an adventurer is just starting to bear fruit or has long since taken root, this pet will never leaf your side when you need it.
items.name: Leafy Neutro

items.description: They say that the famous author Charbo Delaire once called this Seemyool a monster who wears the darkness of its soul on its face. But isn't judging a mount by its appearance a sign of a narrow mind? Only you, the one who rides upon its back, has seen that nothing is more beautiful on the inside than a Neutro Seemyool.
items.name: Neutro Seemyool

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate hats.
items.name: Astrub Knight Helm

items.description: Come helm or high water, this headgear will protect you from blows to the noggin.
items.name: Combatant Helmet

items.description: This cloak won't parry a lunge attack, but it'll keep you nice and warm. Perfect for snowy lands!
items.name: Combatant Cape

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.
items.name: Astrub Knight Cape

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shields.
items.name: Astrub Knight Aegis

items.description: "The best defence is a good offence." Whoever said that has probably never seen this shield. Indeed, it's solidity will keep your mind at ease during your adventures.
items.name: Combatant Shield

items.description: Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.
items.name: Kwismas 652 Treetop

items.description: It's best not to mess with an Astrub Knight. Although they act for the common good of the city's people, they won't hesitate to use their fists if their honour is disrespected.
items.name: Surly Knight Shoulder Pads

items.description: Astrub Knights have the reputation of being remarkably perspicacious. In addition to being excellent fighters, they can manage conflicts to solve the problems of inhabitants of the city peacefully.
items.name: Implacable Knight Shoulder Pads

items.description: Not all knights are do-gooders but the ones from Astrub are convinced that they are. Believing that they alone ensure the peace in Astrub, they usually refuse to get involved in outside problems.
items.name: Do-Gooder Knight Shoulder Pads

items.description: Everyone knows that efficiency is more important than looks when choosing equipment. Astrub Knights are lucky enough to have access to the work of the best smiths in the region, so they don't need to worry about that kind of thing.
items.name: Protective Knight Shoulder Pads

items.description: Don't trust the hype that pushed you to acquire this item – the little wings on these shoulder pads are purely decorative. They won't help you survive a free fall.
items.name: Agile Knight Shoulder Pads

items.description: Don't get all wrapped up in joy and seasons' greetings... It's just a cape.
items.name: Kwismas Cape

items.description: When it trembles, it's not because of the cold. You're looking at a real dancer!
items.name: Trembell

items.description: This exceptional, half-panther, half-dragon mount may not breathe fire, but he'll shine the limelight right on you.
items.name: Panthragon

items.description: When people see your shield, they immediately remember all their debts. What will they have to mortgage to pay off their debts? They shouldn't worry, though – the look is just a strategy to keep yourself safe from perceptors.
items.name: Perceptor Shield

items.description: No mattew what the Wa Odanowwth's admiwews think, they awen't the only ones who love Thwee Kings Cakes. This shield is ample pwoof of that.
items.name: Queen Odasouth Shield

items.description: Legend has it that when the moon is full, Pandalans with telescopes can catch a glimpse of a wodent hopping rhythmically on its surface.
items.name: Tutuyutu

items.description: This gold-adorned cape looks like it cost a fortune. Many wonder how you managed to pay for it. As a perceptor, you aren't at liberty to reveal to the general public what you do with everything you collect. But nobody doubts your honesty... well, almost nobody.
items.name: Perceptor Cape

items.description: Wearing this headband might make you the target of mockery. Indeed, those bumps can mean many things to many people. For you, however, they merely symbolise all the items you've gathered. Is that what they mean by horn of plenty?
items.name: Perceptor Headband

items.description: If you wear this mask around Pandala, you're sure to be mistaken for a Yokai. You'll probably run into plenty of people who think you'll disappear if they touch you. Imagine just how disappointed they'll be when the realise that's not the case.
items.name: Kamiwolf Mask

items.description: In addition to being comfortable in all circumstances, this kimono will give you a very local look for your nocturnal walks around Nolifis Island.
items.name: Kamiwolf Kimono

items.description: With these paws, no one will ever accuse you of sticking your foot in it. Instead, everyone will wonder at how quietly you move around, because you'll now be as silent as a miliboowolf.
items.name: Kamiwolf Paws

items.description: If you're a bit clumsy, this shield is perfect. Don't believe us? Merchants in Pandala say that it will bring you luck, protection and agility; they also say that it suits bearers of a Dofawa perfectly.
items.name: Kamiwolf Shield

items.description: Is your hair flat and lacking volume? Have you always dreamed of a fringe but never dared give one a try? Give the Belladonna do a whirl!
items.name: Belladonna's Rebel Locks

items.description: With this shield, everyone who says you're a toxic person will be... right.
items.name: Belladonna Shield

items.description: This cape doesn't cover as much as the original that inspired it, but at least it won't get in the way when you're running or fighting your enemies.
items.name: Belladonna Cape

items.description: This magnificent collar will make your lovely mug look just like the pistil of a flower in bloom.
items.name: Belladonna Collar

items.description: No one knows what creature moved into this teapot, or even why it decided to hole up inside it. What is certain, though, is that every one of your moves will be spied upon. If that's not your cup of tea, try tying the cover down tight. Maybe that'll keep it from opening.
items.name: Kuppatee

items.description: This cape's refined appearance resembles Fang'e, a Pandawan noble from ancient times who, according to legend, is said to have fled to the moon after a romantic disappointment. The legends don't say whether or not Fang'e can be seen dancing with the wodent that lives there. You'll have to look for yourself.
items.name: Wodent Cape

items.description: This embellished shield represents the wodent that is said to live on the moon. Depending on who's telling the tale, the wodent meditates, dances or is even an excellent apothecary. I suppose the only certainty is that Pandalans have active imaginations.
items.name: Wodent Aegis

items.description: The legendary wodent-in-the-moon is said to have created, with the help of a jade mortar and pestle, a plant-based pastry that grants immortality. Whoever wrote that legend must have had a bit of a mix-up with whatever he was crushing up into elixirs.
items.name: Wodent Ears

items.description: Pandalans wear these scarves during the year of the wodent in his honour. Then, they write wishes on the scarves and tie them to the heights of Aerdala. If a scarf flies away, it's believed it will reach the moon where the wodent-in-the-moon will fulfil the wish written on it.
items.name: Wodent Scarf

items.description: This adult wodent will help you cross crevasses and leap to great heights. Despite its cute appearance, be careful. Some riders swear that in a forest the most dangerous animal of all is an adult wodent.
items.name: Adult Tutuyutu

items.description: After tormenting countless victims with their tormentators, the equally tormented knights decided to switch things up a bit. They went to a blacksmith and ordered five exceptional blades. Once the work was complete and the craftsman had been thoroughly sliced and diced, the adoptive sons of Hissering had to admit that there's nothing quite like a sword to cut all connections with the past.
items.name: Darkness's Tormented Sword

items.description: After tormenting countless victims with their tormentators, the equally tormented knights decided to switch things up a bit. They went to a blacksmith and ordered five exceptional blades. Once the work was complete and the craftsman had been thoroughly sliced and diced, the adoptive sons of Hissering had to admit that there's nothing quite like a sword to cut all connections with the past.
items.name: Flame's Tormented Sword

items.description: After tormenting countless victims with their tormentators, the equally tormented knights decided to switch things up a bit. They went to a blacksmith and ordered five exceptional blades. Once the work was complete and the craftsman had been thoroughly sliced and diced, the adoptive sons of Hissering had to admit that there's nothing quite like a sword to cut all connections with the past.
items.name: Leaf's Tormented Sword

items.description: After tormenting countless victims with their tormentators, the equally tormented knights decided to switch things up a bit. They went to a blacksmith and ordered five exceptional blades. Once the work was complete and the craftsman had been thoroughly sliced and diced, the adoptive sons of Hissering had to admit that there's nothing quite like a sword to cut all connections with the past.
items.name: Drop's Tormented Sword

items.description: After tormenting countless victims with their tormentators, the equally tormented knights decided to switch things up a bit. They went to a blacksmith and ordered five exceptional blades. Once the work was complete and the craftsman had been thoroughly sliced and diced, the adoptive sons of Hissering had to admit that there's nothing quite like a sword to cut all connections with the past.
items.name: Cloud's Tormented Sword

items.description: This bow belonged to a bandit archer of old who used it to finish his victims off from a distance, so as not to get his clothes dirty.
items.name: Riktus Archer's Bow

items.description: This sword belonged to a bandit swordsman of old who couldn't stand chasing after his enemies. He cut off their legs first and asked questions later.
items.name: Riktus Swordfighter's Sword

items.description: This staff once belonged a wandering bandit who was constantly drunk and therefore couldn't pick his victims' pockets without keeling over. He'd use his staff to prop himself up while he got the job done.
items.name: Seasoned Riktus's Staff

items.description: This wand belonged to an enchantress of old who used it to send her enemies to the ash heap... or just turn them into one.
items.name: Riktus Enchantress's Wand

items.description: Grute the Bwork used this sword to cut his opponents' nuts in two, which was usually enough to make anyone give up a fight.
items.name: Grute's Sword

items.description: The life of a Chafer's not as easy as you'd think. But no one's ever bothered to think about what a Chafer's life is like, which is probably why they think it's easy. Turns out that thinking too long about pointless conundrums like this is how the Chafer became a Chafer.
items.name: Koksiks's Sword

items.description: This staff looks strangely like a lance because Goboff the Goblin stuck a sharp blade on the end of his staff to slice into tofu eggs from a distance. Don't bother looking for a rational explanation as to why – Goblins have always played strange games.
items.name: Goboff's Staff

items.description: Kanniball Lektor used this weapon to hunt his prey, make kebabs, and occasionally amuse his children by shooting arrows at their bums when he was feeling playful.
items.name: Lektor's Bow

items.description: The Pandit known as Stroy Zemol used to hit his opponents with the flat of this weapon's blade in order to knock them out without causing a scratch. Usually, one well-placed blow was enough to put them down for the count.
items.name: Stroy Zemol's Sword

items.description: Fyred Ampe the Dark Miner used this pickaxe to carve out the famous bottomless Kruup mine, where Gaddie lived for a number of years.
items.name: Fyred Ampe's Pickaxe

items.description: Hulkrap was a bandit with an uncontrollable kama obsession. Plagued by remorse after each successful heist, he felt obligated to return what he'd stolen... and then started all over again.
items.name: Hulkrap's Axe

items.description: This hammer was used to forge a Kriptonite zip for Captain Chafer.
items.name: Klume's Hammer

items.description: Kloug used to hand out bread to anyone who dared to speak to him. Less generous than it seems when you consider that the bread was rock hard and thrown directly at their heads. He used this wand to judge and punish the innocent.
items.name: Kloug's Wand

items.description: The Manitou Zoth was a former stevedore who liked to simply shift problems along instead of solving them. Yet he was greatly feared in the Zoth community because he shouted much louder than all the others. Naturally, he was promoted to chief.
items.name: Manitou Zoth's Staff

items.description: There's nothing better than this staff for clearing out drains... or the noses of your fallen opponents when they're no longer able to plug them.
items.name: Plunder's Staff

items.description: It might smell of musty old Mush Mish, but the hilt is made of mossy moss.
items.name: Phong Huss's Sword

items.description: When Ektope was alive, he took a twisted pleasure in hammering on anything that moved... and even plenty of things that didn't move, since the poor fellow was as blind as a bat. Needless to say, the situation hasn't improved since his death.
items.name: Ektope's Hammer

items.description: Ougicle's enemies couldn't help but smile when he made their blood spurt with his sword. Even in death, some people retain their sense of humour.
items.name: Ougicle's Sword

items.description: Kakarotz, Karotz's father and a friend of Sangroku, gave Karotz this staff. Unlike Sangroku's weapon, it can't get longer, only shorter, which is honestly not much use for anything other than causing an inferiority complex.
items.name: Karotz' Staff

items.description: Grouillot could kill anyone with a single swing of his dagger. But he didn't need to do it – his opponents died of old age before he could get to them.
items.name: Grouillot's Daggers

items.description: Using this bow, Kubitus was finally able to get rid of his long-time rival Ray Dius. Yet for some unexplained reason, he's felt strangely alone ever since.
items.name: Kubitus's Bow

items.description: On stage, Piggy Paupe often sang into his trident to try to amplify his voice. Not only did it never work, it also ended up killing him during a particularly energetic bit of head-banging.
items.name: Piggy Paupe's Staff

items.description: Rapiat was a rat so stingy that even in grave danger, he avoided using his sword for fear of dulling or dirtying it. Seeing him fighting with his fists, sword in hand, was a truly ridiculous spectacle.
items.name: Rapiat's Sword

items.description: Inferno was well known for his fiery temper, and more than one apprentice got their wings burned trying to imitate him.
items.name: Inferno's Sword

items.description: Styx was blessed with an Olympian calm, drawing the friendship of the small plant-creatures known as bulbydros, who became catalysts for his magic. But they all ran away eventually.
items.name: Styx's Axe

items.description: Mandrin was a thief who specialised in grinding the skulls of Perceptors and their protectors.
items.name: Mandrin's Hammer

items.description: Will Killson was an ambidextrous barber by day and an assassin by night. Though sometimes it was the other way round, and not always at the client's request.
items.name: Will Killson's Dagger

items.description: No, Tracon's sword wasn't a lance. It had a long handle so that it would make a high-pitched whistle when juggled, effectively distracting the Pandulum's enemies... and allies.
items.name: Tracon's Sword

items.description: Mirh's hammer was originally just a mallet for playing the bass drum. Quite by chance, he discovered one day that it makes an even better sound against an enemy's skull, and he never looked back.
items.name: Mirh's Hammer

items.description: When Logram underwent his metalovephosis, he grew so enormous that he could use his staff as a toothpick. That explains why it looks a bit chewed-on in places. Over time, Logram became more humble – no more delusions of grandeur! But he's still just as passionate as ever.
items.name: Logram's Staff

items.description: Kalkaneus's Sword was a two-handed sword, so he had to summon superhuman strength to handle it with just one arm. He was a skeleton, though, so he didn't have any muscles... Some mysteries will never be explained.
items.name: Kalkaneus's Sword

items.description:
From his name, many adventurers used to think that Hichete probably fought with a hatchet, or maybe a machete. If you had asked him about it, he'd have been happy to demonstrate how much easier it is to gut an opponent with a dagger than with a hatchet.

(Place these daggers over already-equipped daggers to change their appearance.)
items.name: Hichete's Daggers

items.description: With his wispy arms, Haku was never an expert in the art of handling a staff. He mainly used it as part of the wizard costume he wore when attending wild role-play evenings with other Zoths. But he was still known to trip up his opponents with it when the need arose.
items.name: Haku's Staff

items.description: When he was still on Kwismas Island, Rint used to dream of adventure. After a hard day's work at Gutenblimp's press, he fashioned his sword from a Kwismas tree branch and went along the Taiga to slay the dragons who, according to him, were hiding inside the gifts.
items.name: Kwismas Goblimp Sword

items.description: This little dragon especially loves shiny, valuable things – anything that could seem like treasure. It even has its own hoard of collected treasures, hidden somewhere where only it can find them. This is probably for the best, given that there's no telling what it'd do to any wandering hands that might try to touch something they shouldn't.
items.name: Dragomore

items.description: This old bandana is just like its defunct owner: previously impeccable, and now still strong but completely tattered. Add in the faint odour of dried blood and rotting fish, and you've got a positively legendary head covering.
items.name: Katar's Bandana

items.description: If you're in need of headgear worthy of a warrior or hair on your head, this tiara is perfect for you!
items.name: Forgelance Tiara

items.description: There's nothing like a hessian cape adorned with metal, reinforced with leather and bedecked with a spare banner to confront the dangers on the Archipelago of Valonia.
items.name: Forgelance Cape

items.description: This solid sheet of metal – halfway between a shield and a shoulder pad – is guaranteed to provide first-rate protection. The Forgelances of Albuera even use it to withstand being charged by boars and loutbears while exploring the forest.
items.name: Forgelance Shouldershield

items.description: What adorable little critter is hiding under this armour? A whisperer? A goblin? Three blind mice? Whatever it is, its actions are what matter and this miniature Forgelance is a model of courage and loyalty.
items.name: Forgescot

items.description: No Redfoux were harmed in the making of this headgear... At least, that's what the crafter told Mogueta when she traded one of her Redfoux for a few balls of wool to crochet into stuffed toys. The subtle scent of blood wafting from the headgear does make you wonder who was harmed, though...
items.name: Redfoux Headgear

items.description: Proudly wear this cape to show everyone how committed you are to your alliance.
items.name: Alliance Cape

items.description: This magical shield reflects the soul of your alliance.
items.name: Alliance Aegis

items.description: With this headgear, adopt your alliance's style and say no to nonconformity.
items.name: Alliance Headgear

items.description: This armoured petsmount is a feisty and stylish way to find bugs safely.
items.name: Test-a-Beast

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shields.
items.name: Albueralive Shield

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.
items.name: Albueralive Cape

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate items of headgear.
items.name: Albueralive Helmet

items.description: The sheer brutality of this mount makes it a weapon of mass deterrence. No one will dare mess with you when you're riding on its back. And yet only you know that deep down, under all the scars and heavy armour, it's nothing but a squishy little gummy bear.
items.name: Bearbrute

items.description: Delinqwolves travel in packs, and if you ever run into one on a dark night, there's a good chance they'll rob you blind. You'll have to show your dominance to get the upper hand and tame the beast. But make one false move and it'll jump at the opportunity to devour you in an instant.
items.name: Delinqwolf

items.description: They say that the Exasperstag is always angry and upset, a real bundle of nerves. Unfortunately, this state of constant exasperation isn't good for its health. But fortunately, you're there to take care of it now, and you'll both feel more relaxed after a nice massage.
items.name: Exasperstag

items.description: In times of war, it's important to have a faithful steed. A mount that inspires power and class. A mount feared by all enemies. But instead, you chose a dragoturkey. Let's hope this harness can inspire something other than mockery on the battlefield.
items.name: Perceptor Dragoturkey

items.description: While it's true that – looking like this – your dragoturkey might smell a bit like cawwots and attract famished Wabbits, you shouldn't let that worry you. All its vital limbs are protected by metal plates. No bites or scratches will injure it any more than the frantic kicking of your heels as you try to urge it to move faster. On second thought... Maybe you should worry – about the tattered state your legs might end up in... Next time, be a bit gentler.
items.name: Lagomorph Dragoturkey

items.description: Originally a member of the Morgotiay clan, Sorond was a brilliant and powerful but unscrupulous warrior who was ultimately consumed by his thirst for power... After the death of his clan master, he decided to take up residence in the Sidimote Moors and raise a powerful army to compete with the other Katiay clans. Using brutal and often underhanded tactics, he won the clan tournament many years in a row before finally being taken down by pint-sized competitors from a friendly and hospitable land, the Hobbitiay clan. As fearful as he was lustful, Sorond had great ambition and suffered an equally great fall.
items.name: Sorond's Helm

items.description: After the Hobbitiay defeated Sorond in the Black Beam tournament, he withdrew to the top of the Sidimote volcano to sulk over his loss. Mad with rage, he didn't notice the little lubricated rubber ring left lying on the ground by a pleasure-seeking young couple. He slipped on it and fell straight into the volcano, where he disappeared amongst the flames, leaving nothing behind but a bad memory for all honest and upstanding tournament lovers.
items.name: Sorond's Fall

items.description: In his fortress of Gangband, now destroyed, Sorond prepared in the shadows to defeat the other Katiay clans. At the heights of the tallest tower of the greatest dungeon, he installed this eye to spy on his opponents, none of whom could hope to hide from its dark and penetrating gaze. On the other hand, no one could see what was happening inside that dungeon, which was just as well, since it was surely a pit of the foulest Sidimotian depravity and debauchery.
items.name: Eye of Sorond

items.description: In his madness, Sorond even attempted to corrupt the leaders of the Katiay Clan, the clan to lead all clans, by whatever means he could think of: lies, flattery, bribes, and even some eyebrow-raising sexual favours. But he had underestimated Shask and Midul, the eternal and incorruptible rulers, who saw right through his schemes and banned him from the tournament for many years. He would return much later, more powerful and conniving than ever, before the brave Hobbitiays finally put a stop to his madness.
items.name: Sorond's Ambition

items.description: Tired of folding yourself over backwards for your ungrateful bow meow? Is it never satisfied, no matter how many gudgeons or mimice you give it? Choose an origami version instead, and you'll never have to worry about such nonsense again.
items.name: Bow Meowrigami

items.description: Yes, this dragoturkey has a better hairstyle than you do. Nobody's saying you lack style in general, but you should mull it over all the same.
items.name: Forgelance Dragoturkey

items.description: This rhineetle armour may well be potentially lethal in real combat, but it is mostly used for regular old jousts organised in Albuera. Each Forgelance stands on their rhineetle, and both mount and rider try to aim for the other mount or rider. This makes for highly technical and impressive "four-handed" fights, but also memorable pile-ups.
items.name: Forgelance Rhineetle

items.description: Equip your seemyool with this armour, and you'll finally be the big fish in your little pond.
items.name: Forgelance Seemyool

items.description: This shield is a relic that holds Goultard's wonderful broken sword. You might be wondering how that Iop could have been so powerful despite his broken weapon. You're right, but that question will scramble your brain less than this one: how powerful could he have become if the sword weren't broken?
items.name: Goultard's Shield

items.description: This cape will definitely make you look stylish as it flaps in the wind in the desert. The one and only condition for you to equip it is that you must be completely bare-chested underneath it. If you're going to look like Goultard, you might as well go all-out. Just remember to bring something for your sunburn.
items.name: Goultard's Cape

items.description: Have you always dreamed of being like the brave and handsome Goultard? The illusion be perfect with these flowing locks... if only your odour didn't give you away.
items.name: Goultard's Flowing Locks

items.description: You know that saying, "He doesn't know his own strength"? Your little friend here has that problem, but in reverse. He thinks he's a colossus, which sometimes leads him to act much more boldly than he should with his frail frame.
items.name: Peebles

items.description: No one knows whose heart it is that adorns this shield, and Belladonna seems to enjoy keeping the mystery unspoiled. While you could try to press her for more information, it's not exactly recommended. The witch of Ephedrya isn't known for her patience, and this heart might be replaced by your own if you pester her too much.
items.name: Bellashield

items.description: This hat is perfect for excitement and adventure! It's also the favourite fashion accessory of the famous archaeologist Nidania Josne, who has somehow managed to hold onto it throughout his countless journeys to every corner of the World of Twelve.
items.name: Nidania Josne's Fedora

items.description: Over the course of his storied career, Nidania Josne has held any number of amazing and unique items in his hands. So who knows what may be hiding in these little bags?
items.name: Nidania Josne's Cape

items.description: When Nidania Josne found this skull at the bottom of a pitch-black crypt, he thought he'd found a relic from distant lands that belonged to creatures made of pure crystal. Only years later, as he was strolling the beaches on the island of Vulkania on a well-deserved vacation, did he realise that it was just a mass-produced knick-knack sold in dozens of tourist traps around the island. So instead of displaying it in a museum, he decided to make it into a shield.
items.name: Nidania Josne's Shield

items.description: This petsmount is a perfect example of the old saying: the enemy of my enemy is my friend.
items.name: Gravler

items.description: Once the servants of the terrible Morgotiay, and later commanded by the equally terrible Sorond, the Bolrogs were his most loyal and fearsome warriors. Sorond was quite the underhanded backstabber in his own right, but he could always count on their strength to bring his enemies to their knees if his usual efforts were insufficient.
items.name: Bolrog Helmet

items.description: As an elite fighting group, the Bolrogs only accepted the clan's fiercest warriors into their ranks. But brute force alone wasn't enough: only the worst sort of depraved lowlifes were awful enough to be selected as Sorond's personal bodyguards. They were also the jailers and torturers at the clan's shadowy fortress of Gangband, which involved a very particular sort of training that we will not describe any further here.
items.name: Bolrog Cape

items.description: Armed with axes, long whips and thick clubs, the Bolrogs were always heavily equipped. From their helmets to their shields, not to mention their dubious choice of undergarments, everything they wore and carried was covered with spikes and fire, all of it forged in the flames of the Sidimote volcano itself.
items.name: Bolrog Shield

items.description: These demonic-looking wings won't let you fly, but they will make you look as huge and terrifying as a proper villain if you're not afraid of getting a little singed.
items.name: Bolrog Wings

items.description: Sorond found this little horned lava creature in an ancient mine beneath the Sidimote volcano while he was looking for a place to build his army's forges. It is perhaps the only living being for whom the despicable clan master ever had any semblance of affection.
items.name: Bluh-Djoun's Bane

items.description: These horns, which any major demon would be proud of, will reveal your bloodthirsty nature to all with discretion and subtlety.
items.name: Dark Shushu Horns

items.description: This cloak will let you hide in the darkness while cackling ominously and terrorising adventurers who are still wet behind the ears. You can also let it flap around behind you to add a hint of drama and elegance to your public appearances.
items.name: Dark Shushu Cloak

items.description: This shield, which seems to be possessed by a shushu, should inspire awe and respect in your opponents. Perhaps they don't need to be told that this eye is a replica created from a precious stone.
items.name: Dark Shushu Shield

items.description: These deep jet-black shoulder pads sculpt your body in a way that makes you look like a lord of all evils. Now you just need to slaughter a few gobballs and make a few children cry, and you'll have yourself a solid reputation.
items.name: Dark Shushu Shoulder Pads

items.description: During an adventure in the ruins of Sufokia, Nidania Josne is said to have met the strange inventor behind this mount. Although it has a few similarities with classic mounts, like its wild nature and the noise it can make, Twelvians still prefer the cuteness, cuddles and petting that only a classic mount can satisfy... even if it means having to clean up their droppings every time they leave an inn.
items.name: Nidania Josne's Roarbyk

items.description: He who wishes to ride far spares his dragoturkey – especially when it's an inflatable one. Avoid puncturing it if you don't want to finish the ride on foot. It's extremely sensitive to rough roads, but also really useful should you find yourself in a flood. Don't forget to take it with you if you're going to the Sufokian seaside for your holidays.
items.name: Inflatable Dragoturkey

items.description: There's nothing worse than getting sunstroke on your way back from the beach. This hat, made from recycled straw, offers more than enough protection for all your sunbathing sessions. Still, don't forget your sun cream!
items.name: Beachgoer Strawnama

items.description: As a big fan of sandcastles, you've managed to get your hands on the ultimate sand shovel. Slung over one shoulder so it's always accessible for any impromptu contests, you proudly show it off as part of your beachwear.
items.name: Beachgoer Sand Shovel

items.description: To swim like a fish or to sink like a stone? Water has never been your strong suit, except for diluting the occasional drink. But thanks to these inflatable shoulder pads, you can still practise your breaststroke while splashing around on holiday.
items.name: Beachgoer Shoulder Pads

items.description: This helmet – created by a talented blacksmith and forged from elements taken from protectors of Ephedrya – is perfect for blending in with them. Ever since the others in her clan started using it to carry out their missions, there have been far fewer casualties. With a bit of luck, it will protect you just as effectively.
items.name: Helmbyob

items.description: After everything you've been through, you deserve to keep this little souvenir of your fight against Silvosse. All the cuts, bumps and bruises are gone now, and all that remains is the glory, the satisfaction of a job well done, and a shield you can carry any day on the calendar.
items.name: Menologium Souvenir

items.description: This shield is mostly made of volcanic rock. Its sturdy construction will protect you from just about anything – even crowds during the busy summer holidays.
items.name: Vulkaegis

items.description:
From the day they're born to the day they die, Yakitoros have but a single passion: charging at their enemies to run them through like a kebab.
This instinct develops at a very young age, well before their horns appear, and drives them to run headlong into everything around them. Over the years, the hunched back that results from all of this charging grows larger and larger as a symbol of their self-sacrifice. So if you ever happen to spot a Yakitoro with an enormous hunchback, it's best to keep your distance.
items.name: Naive Yakitoro

items.name: Innocent Yakitoro

items.name: Carefree Yakitoro

items.description: Solar was especially recognisable for his legendary hair. Vigorous and radiant beyond compare, it was the envy of admirers and seducers alike. Even now it's been brought back from the dead more than 500 years later, it has lost none of its splendour and still shines as brightly.
items.name: Solar's Flaming Hair

items.description:
"You, bright star, majesty at the pinnacle,
Mighty golden sun, the flame's receptacle,
Sword, which our fiery-eyed hero wields,
Sun, a thousand suns within you sealed,
May the stars never forget you,
Oh Solar, our most true"

— "Ode to Solar"
items.name: Solar's Fiery Attire

items.description: Solar's strength depended on the sun's light and heat. He was at his strongest in the middle of the day, when the sun was at its highest, and he waned once the sun had set. At the time, it was said that his power could rival that of Iop himself.
items.name: Solar's Radiant Shield

items.description: Solar was one of the bravest Iop warriors of his time and was the famed Guardian of Javian. Unfortunately for him, the demon Djaul – intent on expanding his influence – killed Solar on that fateful night of 31 Descendre, when Solar's strength was at its weakest point. However, the demon's plans were ultimately thwarted by Silvosse. The god Xelor then named Jiva as the replacement for the ill-fated Solar, but the name of Javian's first Protector would never be forgotten.
items.name: Solar's Burning Memory

items.description: Put on this boater hat and float along to wherever the great river of life takes you. After all, you can't control everything, so why not just go with the flow?
items.name: Scorcheroo Boater

items.description: Put on this boater hat and float along to wherever the great river of life takes you. After all, you can't control everything, so why not just go with the flow?
items.name: Gustiful Boater

items.name: Sweetapir Boater

items.description: Wearing this cape is an artful way to ensure your friends that they're fighting alongside an adventurer with the soul and power of a dragon.
items.name: Arty Cape

Over the years, the hunched back that results from all of this charging grows larger and larger as a symbol of their self-sacrifice. So if you ever come across a Yakitoro with an enormous hunchback, it's best to just stay away.
items.name: Skewer-Happy Yakitoro

items.description: This headgear is made from real Yakitoro hair. As for the horns, don't worry – they weren't obtained by poaching. These noble beasts just spontaneously shed their horns every couple of years. No word yet on how they feel about people like you walking around with their cast-offs attached to their heads.
items.name: Yakitoro Headgear

items.description: If you like long walks in winter, you'll love this cape, which will keep you warm in even the most frigid conditions. The only downside is its beastly stench of Yakitoro, which you'll just have to learn to appreciate.
items.name: Yakitoro Cape

items.description: As the old saying goes, you sometimes have to take the Yakitoro by the horns. Since you've always been prone to taking things literally, you've now acquired a shield with two actual horns on it. Grab hold of them in mid-fight to bop your enemies on the head.
items.name: Yakitoro Shield

items.description: You've ruined multiple pairs of boots from hanging around with Yakitoros, with their obnoxious habit of leaving their excrement everywhere. That's why you decided to pick up these hooves. Based on traditional countryside technology, they can be easily removed and cleaned at any time. And trust us, you'll be using that feature a lot.
items.name: Yakitoro Hooves

items.description: You can't really measure the energy produced by a Tiwabbit Wosungwee. But one thing is certain: thanks to it, your roarped will be faster than anything you've ever seen. You could try replacing it with another creature, but it probably wouldn't work as well.
items.name: Flamboyant Roarped

items.description: You can't really measure the energy produced by a Tiwabbit Wosungwee. But one thing is certain: thanks to it, your roarped will be faster than anything you've ever seen. You could try replacing it with another creature, but it probably wouldn't work as well.
items.name: Earthy Roarped

items.description: You can't really measure the energy produced by a Tiwabbit Wosungwee. But one thing is certain: thanks to it, your roarped will be faster than anything you've ever seen. You could try replacing it with another creature, but it probably wouldn't work as well.
items.name: Airy Roarped

items.description: You can't really measure the energy produced by a Tiwabbit Wosungwee. But one thing is certain: thanks to it, your roarped will be faster than anything you've ever seen. You could try replacing it with another creature, but it probably wouldn't work as well.
items.name: Aquatic Roarped

items.description: Hold this shield above your head and you'll have an excellent sunshade. Unfortunately, it doesn't protect so well against mothers-in-law and ex-girlfriends.
items.name: 653 Champion Shield

items.description: You chose him, and now he'll follow you everywhere!
items.name: Amphibubble Ring

items.description: You chose him, and now he'll follow you everywhere!
items.name: Scorcheroo Ring

items.description: You chose him, and now he'll follow you everywhere!
items.name: Gustiful Ring

items.description: You chose him, and now he'll follow you everywhere!
items.name: Sweetapir Ring

items.description: This sidekick is entrusted to every collector who sets out on a great adventure. This modster is small and inexperienced now, but prepare to watch it grow...
items.name: Amphibubble

items.description: This sidekick is entrusted to every collector who sets out on a great adventure. This modster is small and inexperienced now, but prepare to watch it grow...
items.name: Scorcheroo

items.description: This sidekick is entrusted to every collector who sets out on a great adventure. This modster is small and inexperienced now, but prepare to watch it grow...
items.name: Gustiful

items.description: This sidekick is entrusted to every collector who sets out on a great adventure. This modster is small and inexperienced now, but prepare to watch it grow...
items.name: Sweetapir

items.description: This bag/cape combo is made from scales lost during an Amphibubble's megalteration, making it incredibly tough and giving it a faint odour of the sea.
items.name: Amphibubble Scaly Bag

items.description: You can rest on the end of this cape when you're tired. Apparently, some people can even use it to jump. The pouch on the back will store just about anything, up to and including your kids.
items.name: Scorcheroo Tail

items.description: If nature is your thing, have we got a cape for you! Just be sure to water it twice a week to keep it fresh. The environment will thank you!
items.name: Sweetapir Leafy Cape

items.description: This bag has little wings to help alleviate the weight on its wearer. It works great in calm conditions, but be careful not to get blown away when the wind comes up.
items.name: Gustiful Breezy Bag

items.description: Impress the buoys! Get the gills! These natural vents let your hair breathe and stay cool on hot, sweaty days.
items.name: Amphibubble Cap

items.description: Never be ashamed again just because your ears stick out. With this adjustable bandana, you can set them to just the right angle to consistently look your best.
items.name: Scorcheroo Bandana

items.description: With this hood on, you can easily blend in with local wildlife. No one who sees you from behind will dare to attack you, for fear of being trampled by a wild beast.
items.name: Sweetapir Hood

items.description: With this hat on, even a simple headbutt can be incredibly devastating. When worn by a Iop, it becomes a weapon of mass destruction.
items.name: Gustiful Horned Hat

items.description: This shield has three sharp points on it. Many people assume they're for jabbing enemies with, but the real reason is quite different. In fact, they're mainly used for drying fish.
items.name: Amphibubble Shield

items.description: It has never been possible to determine the source of the flame erupting from the middle of this shield. Just be sure to hold it the right way round unless you want a nasty burn.
items.name: Scorcheroo Shield

items.description: You probably don't want to bring this shield into battle. On the other hand, it'll definitely come in handy for drying out your clothes after a heavy rain. Beggars can't be choosers.
items.name: Sweetapir Towel Rack

items.description: This shield is a perfect combination of a Gustiful's shoe and a cloud. Light to carry but offering heavy protection, it reflects the mood of whoever's carrying it.
items.name: Gustiful Shield

items.description: While some are honoured with Palmes d'Or, you get... these things. There was no red carpet on your last seaside holiday, but your sunburn was pretty red. Such a tourist...
items.name: Palmes d'Amphibubble

items.description: With these shoulder pads featuring detachable claws, you can easily pick your teeth after a good meal. Like the barbecue master you are, never without a chunk of grilled meat in one pocket or another.
items.name: Scorcheroo Shoulder Pads

items.description: At some point during your many nights sleeping in the forest, you started catching a cold more often than not. But no longer! This scarf will protect your sensitive throat from draughts, so you can indulge your passion for camping without limits.
items.name: Sweetapir Scarf

items.description: They say that putting on these slippers is like walking on a cloud. You've always had your head in the clouds, so why not give your feet a turn?
items.name: Gustiful Slippers

items.description: Warm, stylish, and surprisingly high in protein.
items.name: Team Croquette Capeshew
