items.description: Nicola Flannel was a remarkable alchemist who, rather than trying to turn lead into gold, decided to share her talents with crafters. This scarf is one of her finest creations. Woven from gobball wool, it's light and incredibly soft to the touch, with a subtle floral scent. This is all due to the lotion in the vial attached to it.
items.name: Nicola Flannel's Scarf

items.description: Paul Yunban had an extraordinary build for a Twelvian. He was a true giant who could chop down a whole row of tree trunks with a single swing of his axe! His iconic shirt has since become a symbol of strength and stamina for all lumberjacks following in his footsteps.
items.name: Paul Yunban's Shirt

items.description: Long before the colony was founded and the Albuerans eased tensions between the Timberland Rebels and the islanders, there lived a bulkyfallo hunter by the name of Marshmallow Bill. He was as skilled with a bow as he was at spotting his prey's tracks in the Snowbound Timberland. His cape and quiver have been preserved by the islanders in memory of this exemplary hunter.
items.name: Marshmallow Bill's Quiver

items.description: As Wayland often said, blacksmiths are nothing without their tools, which are usually handed down from generation to generation, from blacksmith to apprentice. Weyland's cape contained his mentor's tools, and it could be fastened around the chest to serve as a work apron. This let him quickly grab whatever tool he needed for his painstaking work.
items.name: Wayland's Apron

items.description: This cape is equipped with a lantern on the back to bring light to deep, dark tunnels. This left Stack Anove's hands free to wield his pickaxe more efficiently and dig four times as fast as other miners!
items.name: Stack Anove's Cape

items.description: Olivier, who was always teased for his persistent hay fever and nasal way of speaking, crafted this cape so he could shroud himself in dignity when faced with jeering country bumpkins. Be proud of where you come from, even if it means putting up with a runny nose!
items.name: Olivier Triste's Cape

items.description: Santiagogo was a notoriously unlucky fisherman who, despite his obvious experience, only brought in very few catches. When, after 84 days without so much as a bite, he returned to port with the legendary swordfish that every fisherman there would have liked to hook, he became a local celebrity! He was given this cape to commemorate his lucky day.
items.name: Santiagogo's Cape

items.description: Throughout her life, Nicola Flannel wrote down all her alchemical recipes in this grimoire. When she sensed that the end was nigh, she concocted a potion that made the book as hard as metal, freezing it open ever so slightly. The only pages that can still be read contain a riddle. Some people believe that whoever manages to decipher it will gain the recipe to unfreeze the book and discover its secrets.
items.name: Nicola Flannel's Grimoire

items.description: This basic shield is actually crafted from the first tree trunk felled by lumberjack Paul Yunban. The story goes that he was barely three years old when he uprooted a hundred-year-old elm tree with a single well-placed punch before chopping it to pieces with nothing but his bare hands!
items.name: Paul Yunban's Shield

items.description: Another hunter once challenged Marshmallow Bill to see which of the two could hunt the most bulkyfallos in just one day. As the sun disappeared beyond the horizon, Marshmallow shot his 69th bulkyfallo at the same time as his opponent, who had only hunted 48 of them. So, the opponent carved up the beast and crafted this trophy, which he gave to Marshmallow as a memento of his win. According to the traditions of the good-sport hunter, it is said to have the power to ward off nightmares.
items.name: Marshmallow Bill's Shield

items.description: Wayland knew better than anyone what the battlefield was really like for Albueran fighters. So, he crafted this shield, which could be fitted with two blades for close combat. If a fighter was unable to keep their opponent at a distance with their spear, they could surprise their opponent by whipping out a blade upon contact.
items.name: Wayland's Shield

items.description: Olivier Triste was abandoned in the middle of some fields shortly after he was born. This shield was crafted from the wheat straw the infant lay in and the scythe placed beside him, predestining him to become an honest farmer.
items.name: Olivier Triste's Shield

items.description: Santiagogo was at the end of his rope when he finally managed to catch the coveted giant swordfish. Just as he was struggling to reel in his prey and was about to abandon the trophy of a lifetime to the sea, he saw the life ring attached to his boat. He used it reel in the gigantic fish, and it stayed stuck in there for several hours before someone was finally able to dislodge it!
items.name: Santiagogo's Shield

items.description: Stack Anove's personal pickaxe was set into this shield upon his death as a trophy in his memory. Many miners will thereby remember how effective their own models are... You just have to live up to his reputation!
items.name: Stack Anove's Shield

items.description: This felt hat, which was once owned by Nicola Flannel, comes with two feathers. One of them was dipped in abundance ink, letting her write down her recipes in her grimoire without ever replenishing it. The other one was dipped in invisible ink, letting her write down her secrets with the utmost discretion...
items.name: Nicola Flannel's Hat

items.description: Paul Yunban's plaid shirt barely protected his protruding pecs and forearms from the biting cold on harsh winter days, so his hat was his only comfort during his endless work in the forest.
items.name: Paul Yunban's Hat

items.description: Hunting in the Snowbound Timberland is particularly strenuous, with the biting cold stiffening muscles and causing frostbite. But this extreme temperature didn't seem to faze Marshmallow Bill, who could handle his bow as if all was well. Still, he would start a campfire after each hunt to warm up and toast a few marshmallows, which he enjoyed on his own or with other hunters.
items.name: Marshmallow Bill's Headgear

items.description: Wayland was an Albueran blacksmith renowned not only for the strength of his creations, but also for the intricacy of his engravings on the metal. Since he had to stand really close to the sparks he produced when making them, he created this heavy-duty bandana to protect himself from burns.
items.name: Wayland's Bandana

items.description: This helmet belonged to a legendary miner by the name of Stack Anove. Legend has it, he could mine a hundred tonnes of coal in just one day!
items.name: Stack Anove's Helmet

items.description: We often have strong ties to the story of how we came to be. Being born in a field is an unusual experience, and Olivier Triste clearly realises this. He proudly wears this hat made from the wheat straw found in that very field. The problem is, it gives him constant hay fever, which – you've got to admit – isn't too smart. But it doesn't take much to make Olivier happy!
items.name: Olivier Triste's Hat

items.description: This headgear may not look like much at first glance, but its robust material means you can attach spare hooks to it without fear of losing them. It was also really effective at protecting Santiagogo from sunstroke during his bitter three-day-long struggle with a gigantic swordfish!
items.name: Santiagogo's Hat

items.description: This species of turtle, which is native to the Archipelago of Scales, is sadly on the brink of extinction. Alas, it is essential to the reproduction of the Archipelago's endemic birds, due to the nesting box on top of its shell. A collective of Twelvians are getting together to save them from poaching and ensure that you'll still be able to see these animals centuries from now!
items.name: Cottageback

items.description: If you're broke this Kwismas season, you can always put on this headgear to give your loved ones the most wonderful gift of all: yourself.
items.name: Kwismas Hat

items.description: While it's mainly intended to go over another shield being given as a gift, this wrapping could save your life by taking a dangerous hit instead of you. But you'll still have to come up with a good excuse for its mangled condition when everyone sits down to open their presents!
items.name: Kwismas Shield

items.description: Native to the northern lands, the Wikkan clan have long since made a name for themselves in the arenas of the Kolossium. The sorcerers of this clan are mostly feared for their magic, but they're quite capable in physical combat as well.
items.name: Wikkan Sorcerer's Cloak

items.description: Native to the northern lands, the Wikkan clan have long since made a name for themselves in the arenas of the Kolossium. The sorcerers of this clan are mostly feared for their magic, but they're quite capable in physical combat as well.
items.name: Master Wikkan Sorcerer's Cloak

items.description: While they're already quite powerful on their own, it's when they work in groups that Wikkan sorcerers are most useful to their clan – and most dangerous to their enemies. Together, they can perform powerful rituals and summon natural forces to help them in battle.
items.name: Wikkan Sorcerer's Horns

items.description: While they're already quite powerful on their own, it's when they work in groups that Wikkan sorcerers are most useful to their clan – and most dangerous to their enemies. Together, they can perform powerful rituals and summon natural forces to help them in battle.
items.name: Master Wikkan Sorcerer's Horns

items.description: Every Wikkan sorcerer has several wild magic orbs with them at all times. Depending on where they're equipped, these orbs can be used for a wide range of purposes. In a fight, for example, an orb placed on an arm can serve as a shield or a magical crossbow.
items.name: Wikkan Sorcerer's Orb

items.description: Every Wikkan sorcerer has several wild magic orbs with them at all times. Depending on where they're equipped, these orbs can be used for a wide range of purposes. In a fight, for example, an orb placed on an arm can serve as a shield or a magical crossbow.
items.name: Master Wikkan Sorcerer's Orb

items.description: Wikkan sorcerers' amber jewellery and other equipment are not only a symbol of their role – they also serve as ritual objects and good luck charms.
items.name: Wikkan Sorcerer's Medallion

items.description: Wikkan sorcerers' amber jewellery and other equipment are not only a symbol of their role – they also serve as ritual objects and good luck charms.
items.name: Master Wikkan Sorcerer's Medallion

items.description: These antlers were supposedly created by a Sylvan spirit, but no one knows which one, or even which forest it preferred. It's said that those who wear them can never get lost, even in the densest woods. Then again, the people who say that are the ones who made it back.
items.name: Sylvan Spirit Antlers

items.description: This cloak is the work of an adventurer who crafted it while lost in the forest. Found after five days in the middle of a field of hallucinogenic mushrooms, he swore that his hands had been guided by a spirit with enormous antlers, whose image he reproduced on the garment. No one knows if he ate any of the mushrooms or not, but he definitely believed that the encounter really happened.
items.name: Sylvan Cape

items.description: These shoulder pads have a reputation for being as solid as a rock, even though they're made of roots. You'll never risk tearing your cloak with these on, whether you're pushing through thorn-covered bushes or carrying a wild animal on your shoulder.
items.name: Sylvan Shoulder Pads

items.description: You might assume that the antlers used to make this shield are exceptionally rare. But in fact, it's quite common to find them lying about as you stroll through one of the World of Twelve's many forests.
items.name: Sylvan Targe

items.description: No one knows why or how this pet suddenly grew horns. But in the end, it doesn't matter whether it was a blessing from a spirit or a genetic mutation. Thanks to their glow, you'll always be able to see where you're going, even on the darkest nights.
items.name: Stricks

items.description: The best defence is a strong attack! So it's only natural that this shield would feature a blade of unparalleled sharpness.
items.name: Sharp Shield

items.description: With this headgear topped with two magnificent steel horns, you can sharpen your mind, your vision, or even your favourite steak knife.
items.name: Sharp Headgear

items.description: To be prepared for any kind of danger, it's best to always have sharpened daggers in easy reach, and that's why this cape is so ingenious. At least, that's what everyone else will think... Just don't let them know the blades are fake.
items.name: Sharp Cape

items.description: This plastron provides complete torso protection, but more importantly, it also features a multitude of ultra-sharp blades to ensure that no enemy can sneak up on you from behind. However, the manufacturer recommends that adventurers with long hair should wear it up if they want to keep it that way.
items.name: Sharp Plastron

items.description: Don't judge a bird by its feathers! This pet certainly looks cute and harmless enough, but it can nip fingers clean off with a click of its beak or split tree trunks in two with a flap of its wings. Consider yourself warned.
items.name: Sharpling

items.description: It's said that you'll have to suffer at least a thousand cuts from this petsmount's razor-sharp feathers before you truly master riding it.
items.name: Sharpraptor

items.description: After everything you've been through, you deserve to keep this little souvenir of your fight against Silvosse. All the cuts, bumps and bruises are gone now, and all that remains is the glory, the satisfaction of a job well done, and a shield you can carry any day on the calendar.
items.name: Blessed Menologium Souvenir

items.description: With its festive colours, this cap will remind everyone of your role in making good little Twelvians happy this year.
items.name: Gift Wrapper Cap

items.description: This cap belonged to an illustrious biscuit baker whose memory has faded from most people's minds, but definitely not their stomachs, as his delicious creations are still enjoyed to this day.
items.name: Biscuit Baker Cap

items.description: This cap is infused with a rich scent of brown sugar, reflecting the countless hours it was worn in kitchens where delectable sweets were being made.
items.name: Confectioner Cap

items.description: This colourful scarf will make you look like a Kwismas cracker. Even when you're too wrapped up in holiday preparations to be at your friendliest, the people around you are sure to get a bang out of your presence!
items.name: Gift Wrapper Scarf

items.description: This scarf is infused with an irresistible scent of gingerbread, reflecting the countless hours it was worn in kitchens where tasty festive treats were being made.
items.name: Biscuit Baker Scarf

items.description: This scarf looks as though it were knitted from threads of candy floss. It will keep you warm, but try not to get too close to the fire... You never know!
items.name: Confectioner Scarf

items.description: This shield may not be too convenient for wrapping gifts, but it will help you to repel any Goblimp jokesters who may try to distract you.
items.name: Gift Wrapper Shield

items.description: This shield is fresh from the oven. It's shaped exactly like a real shield, so with any luck, your opponent won't notice that it's actually a giant biscuit. And even if you're defeated, you can always comfort yourself by feasting on the crumbs.
items.name: Biscuit Baker Shield

items.description: This shield allowed members of the sorcerers' and confectioners' guild to protect themselves during their protests against rising sugar prices.
items.name: Confectioner Shield

items.description: This Kwismas-coloured muffler will keep you warm on those cold Descendre nights. It will also keep your snot from dripping onto the gifts you're wrapping to bring a smile to little Twelvians' faces.
items.name: Gift Wrapper Muffler

items.description: This muffler knitted by your grandmother is infused with what most people would identify as just a subtle scent of cinnamon. For you, though, it's the smell of your childhood, and by burying your face in the cloth, you can relive those carefree moments tasting gingerbread biscuits with her by the fireside.
items.name: Biscuit Baker Muffler

items.description: This muffler belonged to everyone's favourite confectioner at the Trool Fair!
items.name: Confectioner Muffler

items.description: Female wabbits are generally quiet by nature, preferring to stay calmly in their burrow sipping on a tasty cawwot juice. Queen Odasouth is no exception. Once, stepping out to gambol in her royal attire, she was instantly recognised by everyone. The poor gal couldn't take a single step without being buttonholed by her subjects, requesting audiences to discuss their "ovewcooked and undewcooked cawwots". Thwarted in her hopes of just a few minutes alone in the fresh air, she hurried back to take refuge in her royal burrow. Since then, she only wears this crown for official ceremonies.
items.name: Queen Odasouth Crown

items.description: Tornado is probably the fastest reindeer you'll ever meet. In the blink of an eye, he can dart from one end of the World of Twelve to the other. Every year at Kwismas, he has to dash off and help deliver gifts. But don't worry – he's so quick that you won't even notice he was gone.
items.name: Tornado

items.description: Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.
items.name: Kwismas 653 Treetop

items.description: This is not a headgear.
items.name: Sky Knight Headgear

items.description: With this resplendent golden armour, you look just like the Last Rampart. All you need is a replica of Noa to complete your outfit.
items.name: Sky Knight Armour

items.description: The lightness of this feather cape provides great ease of movement.
items.name: Sky Knight Cape

items.description: When you put on this headgear, you can strut around proudly with your chin in the air and stop sticking your head in the sand like a strich.
items.name: Strich Skull

items.description: You'll probably want to brag about wearing this cape made from strich skin and feathers, but let's be honest... Could you have crafted it if you were hunting bearbarians instead of birds from the Cania Cirque?
items.name: Strich Skin

items.description: This shield is perfect for adventurers who can't decide whether they want wings or drumsticks. The femur firmly secures the feathers, delicately taken from those poor strich wings.
items.name: Strich Wing

items.description: Strich hunting wouldn't be so easy without this reptile. Its speed lets you stalk your prey, while its bony skin makes it impervious to any unwelcome pecking. In a nutshell, it's a great ally.
items.name: Serplumage

items.description: This purshield is the best way to protect yourself, especially from inflation. Ratshild – the famous Enutrof whose name makes the poor tremble – never went without this essential accessory, not once. Eaten away at by the years and ever-increasing prices, he was on the brink of tears the day he had to part with it. "Back in my day, everything was so much cheaper," the embittered old rat explained.
items.name: Purshield

items.description: Using this equipment, you can pretend to be a strich without making the real birds suspicious.
items.name: Strich Breast

items.description: Thanks to its small size, this pet can snake its way into just about anywhere. It's perfect for rooting out striches hiding in small spaces... and for dusting under your bed.
items.name: Snakerduster

items.description: The number of heroes in the Krosmoz is as huge as the Krosmoz itself. Would you be able to defeat these warriors from across time and space? With this shield, you can at least dream of it.
items.name: Krosfighter Shield

items.description: There's really nothing special about this little sack – it's about as basic as it gets. But it's all you can afford on such a tight budget. Miserly or minimalist? It all depends on your point of view.
items.name: Stingy Sack

items.description: Legend has it that the Kinryu was once the spirit of a golden-scaled carp, living in a spring of the utmost purity. Many Pandalans came to seek the wisdom of the spirit of the spring, who in turn asked them questions about the world he could not see from his watery prison. When the dragon of Pandala looked into the spring one day, he was struck by the spirit's love for Pandala and its people, but also by the spirit's sorrow at the prospect of ending his days in the spring. Thus, the dragon gave the spirit a new form in his own image so that the spirit could roam the world. Ever since, the Kinryu has been a symbol of wisdom, happiness and prosperity for the people of the island, and it is said that every 12 years, he can be seen flying over the island to show how joyful he is.
items.name: Kinryu

items.description: You once found a kama when you were just a child. You were so delighted by this new-found fortune that money became your reason for living. So, you embroidered that very first kama on a headband as a symbol of this passion. Now it's your lucky coin.
items.name: Lucky Headband

items.description: This ritual headgear, crafted in honour of the Kinryu, is polymorphic and establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate items of headgear.
items.name: Dragon Scalp

items.description: During New Year's celebrations, wearers of these cloaks come together in a long line to perform a ritual dance. Each person's body is hidden by the cloak of the person in front, creating the illusion of a scaly body undulating around a bonfire. The first in line wears a dragon's head made out of paper, adding to the appearance of the celebrated creature.
items.name: Dragon Cloak

items.description: Claimed to bring its wearer wealth and prosperity, this shield is decorated for the Year of the Dragon festivities. Although it may seem precious, mass production over a short period of time has led to some sacrifices when it comes to craftsmanship... as evidence by the small "Made in Pandala" lettering hidden inside the handle.
items.name: Dragon Aegis

items.description: Contrary to popular belief, a Kinryu is a dragon-like spirit, but that doesn't mean it's a dragon. So don't bother trying to charm it into giving you a Dofus – you won't get one.
items.name: Ancestral Kinryu

items.description: These golden shoulder pads are reminiscent of a Kinryu. The tradition goes that at the end of the festivities, the people of Feudala set fire to the fur on them for one final, fiery parade. Then, they proudly display the charred shoulder pads in their homes to appeal to the spirits. You can either do the same or keep them intact!
items.name: Dragon Shoulder Pads

items.description: With its baneful breath, this abomination could make even the toughest adventurers' blood run cold. The dark figure casts doubt as to its nature: is it a dragon or a demon?  Either way, the creature seems to have come from another dimension.
items.name: Greathal Ström

items.description: Despite its small size, this sordid creature's bite releases saliva that can melt metal. Alas, its ungainly appearance had already given you a glimpse of its limited potential as a tame little pet.
items.name: Lethal Ström

items.description: This shield is said to bring good luck to its bearer. Its unique design also lets you carry up to three pints. Perfect for limiting trips back and forth from the bar to your table, and for making loads of friends in no time flat by handing out pints to everyone around you!
items.name: Shamrock Shield

items.description: With their combination of elegance and clear evidence of wealth, these shoulder pads are perfect for letting everyone know that fortune smiles upon you. A subtle but important detail is the waterproof coating that makes them impermeable to beer or any other liquid that might be spilled upon your noble person.
items.name: Oirish Shoulder Pads

items.description: Adventurers of the Cursed Shadow know that survival is more important than being first. And there's no better way to protect yourself from a hostile world than this shield.
items.name: Cursed Shadow Shield

items.description: Lurking in the shadows with a hood pulled down over your face, you wait for your moment to arrive. Not the moment of your death, of course – you've been escaping that for far too long as it is – but rather the moment when you take what's coming to you. All the victory and the glory, and the eternal and undying fame.
items.name: Cursed Shadow Hood

items.description: When someone's a pioneer like you are, they need a nice cape. And that's the only thing your opponents will see once you've taken the lead.
items.name: Cursed Shadow Cape

items.description: Minimmortals can't die, or they would disappear. Then again, isn't that what we call immortality?
items.name: Minimmortal

items.description: It's no secret that the greatest magician the World of Twelve has ever known likes to hum as he works. In fact, he sings really well... just not loud enough. So young Aster, while writing the many volumes of the Almanax alongside her uncle, always used to say to him, "Uncle, you should turn up the volume!" You had to be there.
items.name: Almanax Codex

items.description: Risking your life to defend your guild's colours is the life you've chosen. You'll wear this breastplate with pride and take it to your grave.
items.name: Cursed Shadow Breastplate

items.description: Few people know it, but the renowned Morgan Faym'n – now serving in the Amakna Militia and a great believer in neutrality – is actually from the Wikkan clan. Although she now leaves the fighting to other people, her achievements at the time earned her great respect from all her warriors. Some say she could even have taken over as leader of the clan, but her thirst for adventure kept her away from political intrigue.
items.name: Wikkan Warrior's Helmet

items.description: Wikkan warriors hold great banquets to celebrate their victories. Once the party's in full swing and the beer's flowing, nothing seems impossible to them – it's Wikkan jubilation!
items.name: Wikkan Warrior's Cloak

items.description: Despite their fierce temperament, Wikkan warriors, like other clan members, have a strong bond with nature, and their greatest strength lies in their peaceful harmony with it.
items.name: Wikkan Warrior's Shield

items.description: The number of claws and bones on the collar linking a Wikkan warrior's shoulder pads is testament to the warrior's strength and bravery.
items.name: Wikkan Warrior's Shoulder Pads

items.description: Few people know it, but the renowned Morgan Faym'n – now serving in the Amakna Militia and a great believer in neutrality – is actually from the Wikkan clan. Although she now leaves the fighting to other people, her achievements at the time earned her great respect from all her warriors. Some say she could even have taken over as leader of the clan, but her thirst for adventure kept her away from political intrigue.
items.name: Wikkan War Chief's Helmet

items.description: Wikkan warriors hold great banquets to celebrate their victories. Once the party's in full swing and the beer's flowing, nothing seems impossible to them – it's Wikkan jubilation!
items.name: Wikkan War Chief's Cloak

items.description: Despite their fierce temperament, Wikkan warriors, like other clan members, have a strong bond with nature, and their greatest strength lies in their peaceful harmony with it.
items.name: Wikkan War Chief's Shield

items.description: The number of claws and bones on the collar linking a Wikkan warrior's shoulder pads is testament to the warrior's strength and bravery.
items.name: Wikkan War Chief's Shoulder Pads

items.description: The Silver Coolwolf company is a group of Albueran mercenaries known for their brutality. It's said they let out monstrous howls as they close in on their prey, making it impossible to know whether the victim was torn to shreds by animals or Twelvians.
items.name: Silver Coolwolf Mask

items.description: The mercenaries of the Silver Coolwolf company always wear a lance through their fur capes. It seems that the lance was the weapon they used as apprentices before being permitted to join the pack, lending them a strong symbolic value.
items.name: Silver Coolwolf Cape

items.description: This woven fur shield got to be quite stiff and scratchy with all the blood it's absorbed from the mercenaries' victims. Don't worry – it's since been washed... And besides, that only made it more resistant to incoming attacks!
items.name: Silver Coolwolf Shield

items.description: This coolwolf was harnessed and trained by a mercenary troop from birth to become the exceptionally keen tracker and ferocious fighter it is today.
items.name: Silver Coolwolf

items.description: These shoulder pads have metal spikes reminiscent of coolwolf fangs. The spikes are really more for intimidating your opponents than to actually protect you, but upon closer inspection, there is actually some dried blood on them here and there... It just goes to show they can also be used as an emergency weapon if needed!
items.name: Silver Coolwolf Shoulder Pads

items.description: When you want to be first, you'd best have the support you need. With this mount, you'll be ready to head off into a dark world, where you'll have to rely on just yourself. Where every adventurer will try and pull the rug out from under you. So, simply forget that you haven't got a chance, and go for it!
items.name: Cursed Shadow Dragoturkeyes

items.description: Plenty of Miserites have cut off their brethren's heads to ensure their own survival. But few have made enough of a career of it to wind up serving Misery herself. Having acquired their freedom when their miserable mistress was defeated, they now work as mercenaries in the World of Twelve.
items.name: Miserite Executor Headband

items.description: This cape is made up of large pieces of discarded cloth. While you might think it's designed to emphasise the executors' unhealthy aura, this cape's main function is to hide the oozing, bloody whip marks left on their backs from their years of servitude.
items.name: Miserite Executor Cape

items.description: Executors like to intimidate the populace by encouraging rumours that the bony spikes that adorn their shields are carved from the bones of their victims. In fact, though, they're collected from the carcasses of desert monsters with much tougher, denser skeletons than mere Twelvians.
items.name: Miserite Executor Aegis

items.description: This flying head once belonged to one of Misery's executors. There's no need to explain what happened to him when he once made the mistake of upsetting the boss...
items.name: Misery Phantom

items.description: You might think that only bloodthirsty brutes would have joined the ranks of Misery's executors before becoming an independent force, but nothing could be further from the truth. After all, the role clearly required incredible creativity when it came time to mutilate or rearrange a corpse to show off to the world by way of warning or example! Even though they're mercenaries now, old habits die hard...
items.name: Miserite Executor Shoulder Pads

items.description: With great power comes a great hood, so put it to good use.
items.name: Eliatrope King Hood

items.description: Being a hero also means carrying the weight of the world – and of your mistakes – on your shoulders. In your case, there's really not much point in adding a cape, but at least it should bring you some comfort on this difficult path of yours.
items.name: Eliatrope King Cape

items.description: These shoulder pads seem to have been torn from another piece of equipment. As if during a fierce fight, someone had used all their might to pull them apart. But when you see the original piece, you'll see why these shoulder pads are just a big sham.
items.name: Cursed Shadow Shoulder Pads

items.description: This petsmount will take you everywhere except Externam (not that he doesn't want to). Cross his heart and hope to die!
items.name: Ekto

items.description: This mask, worn by all members of the Black Knights mercenary clan, is polymorphic and establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate items of headgear.
items.name: Black Knight Mask

items.description: This mercenary clan was founded by bandits seeking to pay homage to their role models, the original Black Knights. Of course, certain critics will tell you that they mainly did it to benefit from the real Knights' established reputation and to get contracts more easily by taking advantage of the ambiguity. As so often in life, the truth is likely somewhere in between...
items.name: Black Knight Cape

items.description: This shield is the only accessory that will reveal a clan member as a mere copycat, rather than a real Black Knight. Don't let your guard down, though – they may be less cruel than the originals, but they're still no choir boys, and the firearms that go along with this shield can do some serious damage.
items.name: Black Knight Shield

items.description: While this clan's name obviously refers to the colour black right there in the title, it's more a symbolic label than a fashion requirement. There are no official restrictions on the colours of mercenaries' uniforms, which may be surprising at first. Now, if you do happen to run into a knight in black armour, you'll know you're face to face with the genuine Darkness Knight... Which probably doesn't bode well for your life expectancy!
items.name: Black Knight Shoulder Pads

items.description: Mercenaries from the Black Knights clan take on contracts all over the World of Twelve. To get around more easily, they've bred and harnessed creatures with a knack for intimidating their targets.
items.name: Tormount

items.description: This shield will hungrily take care of any wandering hands that get too close to you. Just be sure to put it well out of the way when your sweetheart's around...
items.name: Shieldflower

items.description: With this shield, you'll never run out of magic potion.
items.name: Nilezhield

items.description: This mask will make you feel as though Aerafal has lent his power to even your slightest sigh. The downside is that a sneeze could easily set off a hurricane, so maybe lay off the dragon impression if you've got a cold.
items.name: Emerald Breath

items.description: When you leap into battle wearing this cape, you'll look like a dragon in flight, ready to soar off to the misty horizon.
items.name: Emerald Surge

items.description: You may not be a dragon, but with these wings, you can look down on your fellow adventurers from the dizzying heights of your glory.
items.name: Emerald Flight

items.description: Any fine creation takes years to perfect, whether it's a magic egg or a work of art. Take this shield, for example: some say it took a full 20 years to craft such a convincing simulation of an Emerald Dofus adorning your arm. If you go over it with a magnifying glass, you may find a few faults, but isn't that part of why you love it so much? In any case, rest assured that the artisans behind it are dedicated to producing only the highest-quality work. Who knows what their creations may look like 20 years from now?
items.name: Emerald Creation

items.description: This helmet, a truly distinctive sign of the Blue Flame team, contains a reservoir of rum to allow for continuous combustion. This technology poses an dilemma for the wearer, though. Get lit or get lit, pick one.
items.name: Blue Flame Skull

items.description: They say that Blue Flame pirates love bones and skeletons. Used in all sorts of creative ways, as accessories or even clothes, morbid adornments have become their signature style. That's why this cape comes with a frame made of Crabtun cartilage. Light, flexible and very sturdy.
items.name: Blue Flame Cape

items.description: The Blue Flames' ship does not fly a proud pirate flag. Instead, the crew put the pirate symbol on their shields so that their victims only figure out the terrible fate awaiting them at the last minute. Clever pirates? How strange.
items.name: Blue Flame Shield

items.description: This bandana may look basic, but it's totally fireproof! That way, if flames get out of control, its wearer can cover their head or the head of a creature with them to keep things from getting out of hand.
items.name: Blue Flame Bandana

items.description: They say Krocklebones is so skinny at birth that he's even skinnier than skin and bones. You'll have to take good care of him to avoid fractures. On the up side, you won't have to feed him much at all. A pet for the frugal.
items.name: Krocklebones

items.description: A true pile of pointy bones, Krokeletal doesn't seem like a comfy choice for riding. Still, the Blue Flame crew picked him above all the rest. In the end, his agility is as high as his calcium content – which makes him a very good petsmount. Padded saddle for long rides not included.
items.name: Krokeletal

items.description: Originally named Nigel Snapper, the warrior better known as Guyomu Makatasa Oniwa was once the leader of a ferocious band of highway robbers. Hungry for greater glory, he placed his group in the service of Shogun Tofugawa, who promised him countless battles and entrusted him with guarding his castle. To go with his changed role, he also changed his name to something more Pandalan – and more intimidating, since he'd always had a bit of a complex about that.
items.name: Guyomu Oniwa Helmet

items.description:
"MY NAME... IS GUYOMU MAKATASA ONIWAAAA!!! AS I BREATHE, YOU WILL NOT PASS THE CASTLE GATE!"
— Guyomu Oniwa's last words.
items.name: Guyomu Oniwa Cape

items.description: Astride his powerful steed and wielding his famed yari – a very long traditional Pandalan lance – Guyomu Oniwa actually never used his shield all that much. Instead, he preferred to simply mow down his enemies by charging across the battlefield at breakneck speed. He was given this yari by Shogun Tofugawa himself, after his previous lance was broken. It's said that this weapon once belonged to one of the shogun's long-defeated rivals.
items.name: Guyomu Oniwa Shield

items.description: Guyomu Oniwa was very proud of his name – so much so that he liked to scream it at the top of his lungs when bearing down on an enemy. It all might have seemed a bit ridiculous if he hadn't got such a thundering voice and impressive abilities in combat.
items.name: Guyomu Oniwa Shoulder Pads

items.description: This little boowolf would follow Guyomu Oniwa everywhere, and he eventually got used to having it around. He was always there to witness his master's many feats of prowess, and to keep him company outside of battle. In a cruel twist of fate, the mysterious shinobi who ended up killing Guyomu in a vicious duel was known as "the one-armed boowolf"...
items.name: Oniwa Boowolf

items.description: The Mechasm technology used to design this shield seems as mysterious as the people who created it. When you wear it, you feel as if someone's watching you... as if you'll never be alone again.
items.name: Lokus Shield

items.description: In the old days, it was quite fashionable for gods to set a glowing aura upon their brow when appearing to their faithful followers. Though that tradition has more or less gone by the wayside, you've decided to bring it back with a modern twist by wearing this impressive halo. Best of all, the mortals lucky enough to cross your path will immediately know they're dealing with a higher being... Yes, much like the Krosmoz itself, your megalomania continues to expand without limits.
items.name: Krosmoz Halo

items.description: Gazing upon the immensity of the Krosmoz may give you wings, but you should keep your feet firmly on the World of Twelve. Alas, you're not a celestial bird – if you were catapulted into the eternighty, you'd float for all eternity.
items.name: Extent of the Krosmoz

items.description: Some people struggle to carry the world on their shoulders. But you've got the entire universe on yours... It's enough to make your head spin!
items.name: Krosmoz Spiral

items.description: Ever since a certain charming entity latched onto you, you've had a new sense of compassion for your fellow Twelvians. Sometimes you're even overcome by a wave of maternal instinct... Could you have been touched by the grace of the Great Goddess herself?
items.name: Grace of the Krosmoz

items.description: Born of the breath of the Great Dragon, this creature is as cold as the yawning void between worlds. But don't be fooled: its fire burns with surprising intensity, especially when a manifestation of the Goddess is nearby...
items.name: Fire of the Krosmoz

items.description: Wikkan sages are the guarantors of order and balance within the clan. No decisions can be made without their approval. Whether it's setting off in search of new territories or choosing which gobball will be sacrificed for the evening meal, all Wikkans submit to their opinion.
items.name: Wikkan Sage Shield

items.description: Wikkan sages are the guarantors of order and balance within the clan. No decisions can be made without their approval. Whether it's setting off in search of new territories or choosing which gobball will be sacrificed for the evening meal, all Wikkans submit to their opinion.
items.name: Great Wikkan Sage Shield

items.description: Don't be fooled by the apparent lightness of Wikkan sage shoulder pads. Actually, they're so heavy that their clan's warriors can barely lift their swords when they equip the pads to prove their strength in their version of an arm-wrestling match. But nobody can match a Wikkan sage's strength of mind – for them, the weight of these shoulder pads is nothing compared to the weight of their responsibilities.
items.name: Wikkan Sage Shoulder Pads

items.description: Don't be fooled by the apparent lightness of Wikkan sage shoulder pads. Actually, they're so heavy that their clan's warriors can barely lift their swords when they equip the pads to prove their strength in their version of an arm-wrestling match. But nobody can match a Wikkan sage's strength of mind – for them, the weight of these shoulder pads is nothing compared to the weight of their responsibilities.
items.name: Great Wikkan Sage Shoulder Pads

items.description: Any Wikkan who wants to do so can undergo the sages' trials to reach this rank. Nobody knows what they involve. In fact, those who pass them jealously keep it secret, and those who fail have their tongues cut out so they may never speak of it.
items.name: Wikkan Sage Helmet

items.description: Any Wikkan who wants to do so can undergo the sages' trials to reach this rank. Nobody knows what they involve. In fact, those who pass them jealously keep it secret, and those who fail have their tongues cut out so they may never speak of it.
items.name: Great Wikkan Sage Helmet

items.description: You might think that not many a Wikkan sage would venture onto the battlefield, but that's not true at all. Although they don't excel in the art of combat, they are exceptional strategists, making them essential for catching the Wikkans' opponents off guard and limiting losses.
items.name: Wikkan Sage Cloak

items.description: You might think that not many a Wikkan sage would venture onto the battlefield, but that's not true at all. Although they don't excel in the art of combat, they are exceptional strategists, making them essential for catching the Wikkans' opponents off guard and limiting losses.
items.name: Great Wikkan Sage Cloak

items.description: The two daggers on either side of this headgear ensure that the Master always has a weapon that's quick and easy to draw. The daggers also let them perfect their haircut with just a flick of the head.
items.name: Weapons Master Doulì

items.description: This traditional item of clothing lets the Master execute large, graceful gestures with the utmost ease. Actually, when they wield their sabre, it's more like a dance than an execution.
items.name: Weapons Master Hanten

items.description: The Master uses this shield in an unusual way. In fact, they don't use it to block their enemies' blows – they prefer to throw it at said enemies like a frisbee. So far, they've always hit the taur's-eye.
items.name: Weapons Master Shield

items.description: You might think these getas look too simple to belong to a Weapons Master, but don't be fooled. Their soles are reinforced, adding considerable weight to the Master's kicks and giving them devastating power.
items.name: Weapons Master Getas

items.description: This is the Weapons Master's best pupil. Like any self-respecting tanuki, art is an integral part of its life. This one has chosen to express the art of combat.
items.name: Kinuta

items.description: This swane always looks threatening and makes terrifying hissing sounds, but it's actually a real coward that hides as soon as danger is near. However, it can run very long distances without ever slowing down or complaining, no matter how much weight it bravely carries on its back. So, it's only natural for it to go with the Master every time they set off on an adventure.
items.name: Bookrane

items.description: This shield saved a Stubbyob prince's life when he faced an albino Bwork. It may save yours when you face your in-laws.
items.name: Krollector Soft Oak Shield

items.description: When wet, this shield tends to become a little salami and you may find that carrying it makes you rather ham-fisted.
items.name: Krollector Piggy Shield

items.description: Some Wabbits say that the Wa starved his subjects, going so far as to pull cawwots right from the mouths of hungry Tiwabbits. One day, the unhappy citizens rebelled and took up arms. This shield now symbolises their revolution. Of course, they hadn't realised just how cruel His Majesty Barf I could be, and the rebellious rodents all ended up in a stew.
items.name: Krollector Wosungwee Shield

items.description: The tusks attached to this shield are unstable and can't be used offensively. At the very least, we can say they're a (slight) deterrent.
items.name: Krollector Bworkler

items.description: With its strong smell of black pudding pizza, this shield is your VIP pass to skulking around Sphincter Cell's lair without drawing attention to yourself. Sometimes, smelling a rat is a very good thing indeed.
items.name: Krollector Rat Shield

items.description: Koolich Aid is a symbol for those who rebel against parental authority, homework, tidying their bedrooms, being grounded, and for some young adventurers on a quest of self discovery, even the law. Yet if you ask them directly why they carry it, they'll tell you it's only for emotional support purposes. Guess you'll just have to try it for yourself.
items.name: Krollector Koolich Aid

items.description: What's it doing here?
items.name: Necrobulb

items.description: The characteristic bricks of this cloak will help you blend into the background on the Other Side of the Mirror.
items.name: Ankamian Cloak

items.description: This harness is just perfect for the occasion whether you're celebrating an anniversary or having a wild time at the Trool Fair.
items.name: Festive Dragoturkey

items.description: Don't panic! Despite its delicate appearance, this shield will protect you from your enemies' blows.
items.name: Fluttershield

items.description: If you're too hot, throw this headgear on! The wings will flap lightly in time with your footsteps, offering your sweaty face a welcome breeze.
items.name: Fluttercap

items.description: These wings will make you feel like you're fluttering from flower to flower. Use the feeling to take your opponent by surprise and throw them off balance!
items.name: Butterfly Wings

items.description: This petsmount can wrap its wings around you, making you feel like you're protected by a real chrysalis.
items.name: Fluttermount

items.description: This pet has gone through many stages to achieve this spectacular metamorphosis, from larva to butterfly. You could learn a thing or two from them.
items.name: Flutterpet

items.description: You won't believe your eyes! These aren't the grumpy Black Bear's shoulder pads, nor the unlucky Black Bow Meow's. No, these are the one and only pair of shoulder pads belonging to the one and only Black Crow.
items.name: Black Crow Shoulder Pads

items.description: Proof positive that your guild's reputation rests entirely on your shoulders.
items.name: Guild Shoulder Pads

items.description: Put this scarf on to keep your neck nice and warm. Just be careful not to stain it when eating grilled meat right off the skewer.
items.name: Scorcheroo Scarf

items.description: We've told you plenty of times before, but please, don't jump off a cliff assuming you'll glide gracefully away. Your premature death would totally kill the vibe.
items.name: Enutrof Wings

items.description: This breastplate is made of sharpened blades closely fitted to the wearer's body. Perfect for maintaining a close shave, blocking unexpected attacks and fending off clingy admirers.
items.name: Sharp Wings

items.description: With these armour components, you can jump into the fray without the slightest fear. However, take care to avoid shrugging your shoulders, unless you want people to start calling you Scarface.
items.name: Sharp Shoulder Pads

items.description: Arjan wore these sparkling shoulder pads so that the gods could see him coming. And now it's your turn to wear them. Just don't expect to shine quite as brightly as him... Still, if you ever fall off of your pedestal head-first, tuck in your head quick enough and you might avoid breaking your neck. Might be the most glorious result you can realistically hope for.
items.name: Arjan's Shoulder Pads

items.description: These shoulder pads are so shiny that even the slightest movement is enough to blind any attacker – really give them an eyeful.
items.name: Aurum's Shoulder Pads

items.description: Even a company that calls itself "the Black Knights" has more than just fighters in its ranks. How would these mercenaries manage their money without a Black Treasurer? What would they eat without the brilliant and talented Black Chef? Yes, it takes all kinds to make a clan!
items.name: Black Knight Breastplate

items.description: Look down and you can see each of your individual nose hairs reflected in the highly polished metal of these shoulder pads. Aren't they magnificent? (The shoulder pads, not your nose hairs.)
items.name: Azure Shoulder Pads

items.description: While these shoulder pads certainly make you look important, don't let people look too closely, as the materials are probably knockoff quality at best. Truly, no one is safe from dishonest vendors taking advantage of their customers' ignorance.
items.name: Samurai Shoulder Pads

items.description: Thanks to the thick fur adorning these shoulder pads, you can walk right up to various wild beasts and they'll just think you're one of them.
items.name: Trapper Shoulder Pads

items.description: These wings have no practical use, and are only there to further accentuate an already menacing look with the drops of blood that occasionally drip from them.
items.name: Sacrier Wings

items.description: These tough, sturdy shoulder pads will let you easily absorb even the most powerful hits. But if you don't think you need them, or if you're afraid of being taken for a Iop, you can always use them as cereal bowls.
items.name: Iop Shoulder Pads

items.description: The number of bones and claws on a Wikkan warrior's collar are a measure of their strength and bravery.
items.name: Wikkan Warrior Medallion

items.description: The number of bones and claws on a Wikkan warrior's collar are a measure of their strength and bravery.
items.name: Wikkan War Chief Medallion

items.description: Wikkan sorcerers' power comes mainly from their magic and their sacred rites, but they also have no trouble hacking their way to the heart of a pitched battle if needed.
items.name: Wikkan Sorcerer Shoulder Pads

items.description: Wikkan sorcerers' power comes mainly from their magic and their sacred rites, but they also have no trouble hacking their way to the heart of a pitched battle if needed.
items.name: Master Wikkan Sorcerer Shoulder Pads

items.description: The magnificent petals that adorn these shoulder pads really bring out your beautiful eyes and rosy cheeks.
items.name: Belladonna Shoulder Pads

items.description: These wings illustrate the path that Katar's mind has followed over the years: dark, tortured and grotesquely twisted.
items.name: Katar Wings

items.description: These wings are the most obvious sign of Hecate's demonic origins. But since the Protector of Jullier is such a mischievous shape-shifter, she doesn't wear them often. That's probably why you didn't recognise her last night...
items.name: Hecate Wings

items.description: Leorictus was the king of Bonta at the time of Djaul's attack in 553. Through a flawless deployment of the White City's forces, the monarch led his people to a resounding victory. However, the events that followed showed that even though he had the right shoulder pads, he could no longer shoulder the burden.
items.name: Grimacing King's Shoulder Pads

items.description: With their lovely leaf-green colour and gilded edges, these shoulder pads will bring a touch of spring to any outfit you wear. Of course, they won't quite give you the same supernatural elegance as Rosal, but it'll still be a better look than the rusted old mismatched armour you usually have on. Perhaps your endless thirst for blood will even be stilled for a moment as your soul takes comfort in the natural beauty of a flower... But don't worry, it's only temporary. Once that feeling has passed, you'll be back to slaughtering gobballs with a smile on your face and a song in your heart.
items.name: Rosal's Soothing Shoulder Pads

items.description:
"Sadism is an expression of our true nature. Blessed are those who don't hide from this fact, as they are the messengers of our fundamental identity and the scope of our true abilities."

— Oto Mustam, "Vices and Virtues of the Dark City"
items.name: Sadism of the Dark City

items.description: Essential accessories for anyone looking for a touch of class as they take on the challenges that fate has in store for them! That being said, these shoulder pads won't be of much use if you're having trouble opening a fresh jar of jam.
items.name: Yugo the Eliatrope Shoulder Pads

items.description: These feathered shoulder pads remind you of the days when you proudly wore a splendid piwi set. Back then, you had to decide between taking the zaap or buying halfway decent equipment... Ah, the good old days.
items.name: Strich Shoulder Pads

items.description: At a time when most ordinary mortals had to make a choice between Bonta and Brakmar, a few rare individuals joined a clan of mercenaries. Neither angels nor demons, they were known for their brown canvas clothing.
items.name: Mercenary Scarf

items.description: Among the various celestial birds that inhabit the Krosmoz, the Eagles are distinguished by their wisdom. They are also a uniquely versatile group, known for being scholarly and pragmatic, with deep experience in the arts of war. In light of all that, it's quite natural that some of them would take on the role of mentor in Incarnam.
items.name: Celestial Eagle Frontlet

items.description: It's said that this cape was created by Master Attwerk himself. Not all newly incarnated souls are fated to become warriors... Those more inclined to the crafting professions can count on a Celestial Eagle to guide them.
items.name: Celestial Eagle Cape

items.description: Master Ganymede's words echo in your mind as you look upon this shield. "Will you be the new guardian of the Dofus? Only time will tell."
items.name: Celestial Eagle Bastion

items.description: Master Sension is the guardian of the portal that takes souls from Incarnam to Astrub. But certain longtime adventurers still remember a time when a celestial balloon would set them down before the statue of their god.
items.name: Celestial Eagle Breastplate

items.description: A tabi is a bit like a tofu, only much larger, woolly, and with teeth. So in other words, not that much like a tofu.
items.name: Tabi

items.description: We'd normally tell you to look at the dragoon's colour for an idea of what it's capable of, but in this case, just listen to your heart.
items.name: Chromatic Dragoone

items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
items.name: Trophy Dark Vlad Shield

items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
items.name: Trophy Soft Oak Shield

items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
items.name: Trophy Bworker Shield

items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
items.name: Trophy Dragon Pig Shield

items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
items.name: Trophy Kimbo Shield

items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
items.name: Trophy Koolich Shield

items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
items.name: Trophy Minotoror Shield

items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
items.name: Trophy Wa Wabbit Shield

items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
items.name: Trophy Moon Shield

items.description: Hold it high and proud, because this trophy is all that will be left of your glory when you're gone.
items.name: Trophy Sphincter Cell Shield

items.description: Having horns on your back can be incredibly useful at times. For example, when you're lying on your stomach and an enemy happens to fall right onto you... This kind of situation is when the Hornbearer Cape really pays off.
items.name: Hornbearer Cape

items.description: With this shield, you can practice taking the Vetauran by the horns. Although... you do know that's just an expression, right?
items.name: Hornbearer Shield

items.description: It's said that the wise wear their horns in their hearts, and that fools wear theirs on their foreheads. By wearing these shoulder pads, you'll show a kind of wisdom about your foolishness.
items.name: Hornbearer Shoulder Pads

items.description: The adventurers with the most inspiring destiny are often those who leave the most enemies expiring messily. Master Tarms makes sure the souls warm up their wrists before any shoulder massages.
items.name: Celestial Eagle Epaulettes

items.description: You won't be able to lay the Emerald Dofus just by putting on a simple costume. But with this high-flying outfit, you might find some work as a temporary egg-sitter.
items.name: Emerald Vigour

items.description: These shoulder pads give you an upright and determined appearance. You'll need it to properly honour the sacrifice of Jiva's Champion.
items.name: Sky Knight Shoulder Pads

items.description: The feathers actually make you look legendary. Plus, if you do that sideways pose, you can pretend you're on a coat of arms.
items.name: Griffined Shoulder Pads

items.description: The fur stitched on these shoulder pads will soften blows, but it won't protect against the crowd turning against you due to mediocre rasslers.
items.name: Siks Wonn Ein Epaulettes

items.description: In the end, there's not much difference between this little guy and a dragon...
items.name: Tofus

items.description: Only the most important Wikkan shamans have the privilege of wearing Stag God attire during the clan's major ceremonies. In this sacred garment, they can summon the blessings of the King of the Forest to ensure the clan's prosperity.
items.name: Great Stag Finery

items.description: These impressive antlers will make you the king of the forest. Like the Stag God, you too will have privileged access to any shrub you choose, including exclusive urination rights.
items.name: Great Stag Antler

items.description: Wikkans believe in the Stag God, a woodland god who is half-stag, half-man (and half-stag again at the back), able to give life and take it away at will. Also known as the King of the Forest or the Great Stag, he is said to be the guardian of the woods and to grant his powers to the most zealous members of the clan.
items.name: Great Stag Aegis

items.description: Legend has it that with every step the Stag God takes, magnificent flowers burst forth from the soil, then instantly wilt in his wake.
items.name: Great Stag Hooves

items.description: Only the most important Wikkan shamans have the privilege of wearing Stag God attire during the clan's major ceremonies. In this sacred garment, they can summon the blessings of the King of the Forest to ensure the clan's prosperity.
items.name: Stag God Finery

items.description: These impressive antlers will make you the king of the forest. Like the Stag God, you too will have privileged access to any shrub you choose, including exclusive urination rights.
items.name: Stag God Antler

items.description: Wikkans believe in the Stag God, a woodland god who is half-stag, half-man (and half-stag again at the back), able to give life and take it away at will. Also known as the King of the Forest or the Great Stag, he is said to be the guardian of the woods and to grant his powers to the most zealous members of the clan.
items.name: Stag God Aegis

items.description: Legend has it that with every step the Stag God takes, magnificent flowers burst forth from the soil, then instantly wilt in his wake.
items.name: Stag God Hooves

items.description: Born and raised among the renowned builders of the Mamija Clan, Chun-Leia began learning martial arts at the age of five. Building on her father's famous kick-heavy style, the young Pandalan developed her own style inspired by the various schools of Pandawushu. At just 18 years old, she joined an elite group serving the Daimya to push back against the secret organisation known as the Chtiger's Fist, whom she believes to be responsible for her father's death.
items.name: Chun-Leia Diadem

items.description: As the centrepiece of any Pandalan woman's wardrobe, the qipao embodies the elegance and versatility of Pandalan femininity. This long, flowing qipao is a traditional version, whereas more recent models have tended towards a shorter, closer-fitting style.
items.name: Chun-Leia Qipao

items.description: In Chun-Leia's hands, this shield – a gift from her late father – is as likely to be used as an offensive weapon as for defence. It's equally effective in both roles.
items.name: Chun-Leia Shield

items.description: Whilst fleeing Chtiger's Fist cultists in Pandala Forest, Chun-Leia crossed paths with a strange minifoux known as Wikett. Though quite fearful and skittish at first, Wikett was quickly won over by the fighter's kindness after she offered him some of her food. Just when the cult assassins were about to catch Chun-Leia, Wikett distracted them, allowing the young Pandalan to regain the upper hand. Ever since, the two have been inseparable.
items.name: Wikett

items.description:
Ladies and gentlemen, step right up
Excitement galore, I see you holding your breath
That's right – you too can be a proud part of
The timeless battle between life and death
The look has changed, but the fun goes on
The fair will still be here when we're all dead and gone!
items.name: Big Show Epaulettes

items.description:
Ladies and gentlemen, step right up
It's finally your turn – it's about to begin!
Even when you're losing, stay tough and hang in
A hard fight, but you just can't resist, now can ya?
So don't run away and get lost in Cania
And one day, you'll take home a big win!
items.name: Big Show Tail-Coat

items.description:
Ladies and gentlemen, step right up
Don't be shy – the show's about to begin!
Make your way up to the stands and settle in!
Five, four, three, two, one... zero! Let the balloons fly, up they go
Are you ready for our great big show?
items.name: Big Show Hat

items.description: Zi was reputed to be the most famous troubadour in the World of Twelve. He quickly rose to the highest heights of society in the southern kingdoms. But what people tend not to know is that this reputation enabled him to organise a host of events for noble causes. So, like Zi, you too should be generous, because every little thing you do counts.
items.name: Zi Helmet

items.description: This diadem, inspired by the lush vegetation of a bygone age, is a nostalgic reminder that nothing lasts forever.
items.name: Retrofus Diadem

items.description: Fashion trends come and go, or so they say. Perhaps that's why this cloak is back in the limelight after a 20-year absence.
items.name: Retrofus Cloak

items.description: Beauty through simplicity and minimalism is what the creator of this shield set out to achieve. Despite its crude appearance, it still brings back sweet childhood memories.
items.name: Retrofus Shield

items.description: Of course, it needs to be pumped up so it doesn't hang down like an old relic, and it can pop at any time. But at least you won't need to sharpen it. With all those colours, this is a weapon that's sure to brighten up your battles!
items.name: Gladiatrool Sabre

items.description: Thanks to its reinforced rubber structure, this shield will soften any blow. But don't forget to stock up on patches and save your breath – you'll need it.
items.name: Gladiatrool Shield

items.description: Unlike protection gear that weighs two hundred kilopods, this armour doesn't hinder your movements. However, it does tend to squeak a bit when you move. The noise will annoy your opponents, but if you're looking to be sneaky, be warned.
items.name: Gladiatrool Armour

items.description: During an excavation deep in the abyss, Foggernauts found a fossilised moskito. Since this creature had lived long ago, they were able to use their technology to create copies of the last monster it had bitten. Then they armed the beast and named it: the T-Rumb.
items.name: T-Rumb

items.description: Even your mother won't recognise you with this helmet on your head. Which is probably for the best, because it would be embarrassing if she came into the arena and called you "my little kikitten" in front of all the spectators.
items.name: Gladiatrool Tamer Helmet

items.description: Even your mother won't recognise you when you pull up this hood. Which is probably for the best, because it would be embarrassing if she came into the arena to bring you a snack in front of all the spectators.
items.name: Gladiatrool Acrobat Hood

items.description: Even your mother won't recognise you with this hat on your head. Which is probably for the best, because it would be embarrassing if he came into the arena showing off your washed, ironed and lavender-scented underwear in front of all the spectators.
items.name: Gladiatrool Magician Hat

items.description: When a bluff is about to be called, there's nothing like a good swipe under the table to distract an overly attentive opponent.
items.name: Bluffer Claws

items.description: Love 'em or hate 'em, these crocks guarantee unrivalled comfort. If only we could be as appreciative of their appearance.
items.name: Beachgoer Crocks

items.description: This strange-looking helmet was crafted from moon fragments found in a place where night never falls. Warmed since the dawn of time by a fractured sun, they acquired the power of both heavenly bodies. Those who place this helm on their head feel as calm as a summer night, and as confident as if they were glowing with power.
items.name: Astral Helm

items.description: The perfect symbol of the balance between heavenly bodies, this shield represents the opposition between different moments in the life of its bearer. On the one side are the defeats which remind them to never forget where they came from, and on the other are the victories that remind them of what they've accomplished.
items.name: Astral Targe

items.description: Some see gods when they look to the heavens. Others seek guidance for the path they wish to follow. In this case, it's the power of both celestial bodies – and especially that of the sun – that has imbued the fabric from which this cape is crafted. That's why the wearer feels a comforting sense of warmth when slipping it on.
items.name: Astral Cloak

items.description:
"Discipline alone can lead a people to unity; for it is thanks to discipline that our spirits and our wills resound as one and overwhelm our enemies."

— Amayiro, "Vices and Virtues of the White City"
items.name: Discipline of the White City

items.description: At last, a shock-absorbing mount that lets you bounce back in a whole host of situations! Just make sure you stay away from prespics, or instead of playing tofu smasher, you'll be playing tofu puncture.
items.name: Tofusen

items.description: No matter what your destination, life is just one big adventure where you're always meeting new people. So, wearing your brand-new costume, you've decided to make a fresh start. Together with your longtime friends – or the new ones you meet along the way – you'll set out to conquer this unknown (or not-so-unknown) world. This adventure is your own.
items.name: JanKenPon Costume

items.description: In this bag, you'll find a few sheets of paper, a pair of scissors and a fairly large rock. They're strange items that take up a fair amount of space, but if you pull them out at the right time, they can defeat any enemy.
items.name: JanKenPon Bag

items.description: Choosing a pet with the relative strength of an ant was obviously a wise choice. After a life spent working as a sherpa, helping adventurers to build themselves up by climbing the highest peaks in the World of Twelve, the Binzu decided to take things a bit slower. Following you around while carrying your modest kit will be a walk in the park for it.
items.name: Binzu

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate items of headgear.
items.name: Chimeritinem Helmet

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.
items.name: Chimeritinem Cape

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shields.
items.name: Chimeritinem Shield

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shoulder pads.
items.name: Chimeritinem Shoulder Pads

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate costumes.
items.name: Chimeritinem Costume

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate wings.
items.name: Chimeritinem Wings

items.description: The ardour of a lion cub, the deviousness of a snake and the fury of a dragon. It's an explosive mix that will give you no respite. But when you're adopting a pet, you've got to be prepared to make a few sacrifices.
items.name: Chimeritten

items.description: It took weeks to charm the snake, months to tame the lion and years to appease the dragon. But your persistence has paid off, because you now have a petsmount as loyal as it is majestic.
items.name: Archimera

items.description: This Kobrapid's scales seem to reflect light in different colours depending on the angle from which you look at it. Sometimes it's camouflaged, and sometimes it's visible from a kamile off – you can decide whether you prefer discretion or flash.
items.name: Iridescent Kobrapid

items.description: When that slightly tipsy Iop you met at the Amakna Inn mentioned a pink Kolophant, you chalked it up to the 24 beers he'd just downed. Well, now you've got your own colour-changing specimen. You should never be fooled by appearances.
items.name: Many-Hued Kolophant

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate items of headgear.
items.name: Nut'Itinem Shoulder Pads

items.description: White gets dirty so easily. So, Mama Troolette prefers colourful gobbtrools, as they match her outfit and absorb bloodstains.
items.name: Troolette's Gobbtrool

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate items of headgear.
items.name: Samuralive Shoulder Pads

items.description: Have you always dreamed of having a Trool mane? Thanks to Mmbah's talent, not only is it now possible – it's even recommended, especially for those who want to venture into Eltneg Wood while avoiding any hairy encounters.
items.name: Trool Fair Headgear

items.description: If certain rumours are to be believed, carrying a Fair bag will dramatically increase your odds of winning the jackpot at the wheel of gobbtune. They're obviously just trooling you. But the unique design and quality of this item still make it a must-have.
items.name: Trool Fair Bag

items.description: This shield dedicated to a famous attraction was awarded as a prize in a big creative contest, and it will let you push your luck much more than usual. Plus, it'll look great alongside your rubber quaquack.
items.name: Trool Fair Shield

items.description: You've always preferred the shadows to the light, but in the past few years, your organisation has really taken centre stage. You wear its colours proudly, yet still never forget where you came from.
items.name: Solary Costume

items.description: When you step into the arena, you come to win, but also to defend those you hold dear. You specialise in defence, but you know how to strike back as well. Never trust a sleepy old-timer.
items.name: Aegis Costume

items.description: Your whole life, you've felt alone... different. One day, an ordinary conversation turned to a secret organisation where people like you could connect. You found a family there, with members willing to sacrifice themselves for you, and for whom you'd gladly do the same. The fact is, you were never really lost; you were just moving towards your goal. And now you've finally found it.
items.name: Karmine Corp Costume

items.description: As far back as you can remember, you've always had a knightly soul. Honour and loyalty are more than just words to you. And when you found some brothers-in-arms to share your adventures with, you felt a strange sense of gratitude. To them, of course, but especially to the fates, who had finally smiled upon you.
items.name: Gentle Mates Costume

items.description: The mask attached to these shoulder pads was crafted by a traditional process to infuse it with a special form of magic that lets the wearer obscure their presence. It also hides your face during operations that call for discretion.
items.name: Solary Shoulder Pads

items.description: These shoulder pads are made of Fecanium, a practically indestructible material that's still surprisingly flexible and light. It also stands up to the ravages of time and grows tougher over the years... a bit like the people who wear them.
items.name: Aegis Shoulder Pads

items.description: Shoulder pads adorned with dragon skulls are obviously a bit intimidating. Apparently, when the wearer finds themself in a tight spot, blue smoke even emerges from the animal's nostrils – a call for help that your brothers-in-arms will never hesitate to answer.
items.name: Karmine Corp Shoulder Pads

items.description: You never fight without your sword – it's your trademark. But if ever an opponent managed to steal it from you, you could just smash them in the ribs with one of your shoulder pads to remind them you've got more than one trick up your sleeve.
items.name: Gentle Mates Shoulder Pads

items.description: You proudly wear your clan's colours everywhere you go. Your devotion is so intense that it eventually convinced your friends to start following you. You weren't a leader before, but you've grown into the role.
items.name: Solary Banners

items.description: It's said that these wings of light were given to the members of the Aegis clan by a god who wished to remain anonymous. As a symbol of their devotion, particularly towards other members of their community, it seems the light's intensity relates to the serenity of the wearer.
items.name: Aegis Wings

items.description: These blue flames shooting out of your back burn at a much higher temperature than normal. Like an enraged army led by an inspiring leader, you burn everything in your path, leaving only the ashes of your enemies behind you.
items.name: Karmine Corp Flames

items.description: The blades floating around your shoulders will turn to point straight at your enemies if they get too close, a powerful deterrent that will ensure no one bothers you throughout your adventure. Who would dare take the risk?
items.name: Gentle Mates Blades

items.description: Surviving Lary assaults is extremely difficult, due to their capes that allow them to hide in the shadows before delivering the final blow for a brilliant victory.
items.name: Lary Veil

items.description: The Lary assassins are a group of elite fighters who have won countless battle competitions in the World of Twelve over the years. Their reputation speaks for itself, and their clan is crowned in glory.
items.name: Lary Hood

items.description: Always ready for a fight, members of the Lary clan can snap a secret blade out of this gauntlet with a simple flick of the wrist. They're very dangerous in close combat, so your team should strike the Lary simultaneously to avoid being picked off one by one.
items.name: Lary Secret Blade

items.description: The Lary clan's equipment is all marked with a mysterious seal known in their strange tongue as the Sceau Lary, granting them precision and focus during fights.
items.name: Lary Spaulders

items.description: Surviving Lary assaults is extremely difficult, due to their capes that allow them to hide in the shadows before delivering the final blow for a brilliant victory.
items.name: Lary Masters Veil

items.description: The Lary assassins are a group of elite fighters who have won countless battle competitions in the World of Twelve over the years. Their reputation speaks for itself, and their clan is crowned in glory.
items.name: Lary Masters Hood

items.description: Always ready for a fight, members of the Lary clan can snap a secret blade out of this gauntlet with a simple flick of the wrist. They're very dangerous in close combat, so your team should strike the Lary simultaneously to avoid being picked off one by one.
items.name: Lary Masters Secret Blade

items.description: The Lary clan's equipment is all marked with a mysterious seal known in their strange tongue as the Sceau Lary, granting them precision and focus during fights.
items.name: Lary Masters Spaulders
