items.description: You might think the Queen Odasouth really feels the cold, but that's really not the case! Actually, she always feels too hot, and she would much rather go around in the simplest of attire. Sadly, etiquette won't allow it. That means you should expect this to be quite a lightweight cloak.
items.name: Queen Odasouth Cloak

items.description: This cloak seems to be made from a material of unlimited stretchiness. It makes projectiles rebound that would otherwise have hit the wearer. But be careful not to get too close to fire – the smell this material gives off when it burns is suffocating, and it will linger for weeks on end.
items.name: Stretshu Cloak

items.description: Come rain or shine, this cloak lets the marvellous woman fend off opponents' attacks.
items.name: Marvellous Woman Cloak

items.description: This diadem symbolises the marvellous woman's poise, but it can also be used to decorate a Kwismas pricky.
items.name: Marvellous Woman Diadem

items.description: The marvellous woman has a wide variety of superhuman abilities: strength, speed, deflecting projectiles and locating the Cania bandits.
items.name: Marvellous Woman Shoulder Pads

items.description: Apparently, the Serpor's venom has incredible medicinal qualities, but only if extracted on Lunar New Year's Eve. So, you know what to do.
items.name: Serpor

items.description: The scales covering this helmet make it perfectly waterproof, keeping your hair safe from the elements.
items.name: Ophidian Helmet

items.description: When you walk, the tail sewn onto this cloak moves in a way that makes you look like a real cool-blooded reptile.
items.name: Ophidian Cloak

items.description: In the inns of Pandala, rumour has it that the snake engraved on this shield can come to life and go for your enemies' throats. The rumour probably came from a Pandawa who'd overdone it a little on the beer, but you never know...
items.name: Ophidian Shield

items.description: These shoulder pads don't just look sharp. While they'll offer you a style that's got some bite, be warned – you won't be able to raise your arms without getting bitten yourself.
items.name: Ophidian Shoulder Pads

items.description: Every time you take off this costume, you'll feel like you're shedding your skin.
items.name: Ophidian Costume

items.description: It may seem friendly, but you should never risk hugging an ophgildian – you could end up utterly crushed in just a matter of seconds.
items.name: Ophgildian

items.description: Have you got a bone to pick with someone? Look no further – osteomancy is what you need!
items.name: Osteomancer Shoulder Pads

items.description: If you ever find yourself drowning, you could always use these shoulder pads as floats.
items.name: Aqueous Panache Shoulder Pads

items.description: Once you've equipped these shoulder pads, they'll give off a pleasant scent of humus whenever you turn your head.
items.name: Botanic Panache Shoulder Pads

items.description: With shoulder pads like these, you're sure to have your head in the clouds.
items.name: Volatile Panache Shoulder Pads

items.description: You won't need a scarf while wearing these shoulder pads!
items.name: Fiery Panache Shoulder Pads

items.description: This gobbly has followed you from Incarnam to help you as you make your first steps in the World of Twelve. He's still a bit puny, but he'll do his best to help you break in your weapons.
items.name: Young Celestial Gobbly

items.description: Legend has it that you received this shield because of your exceptional monster-massacring and noble-disembowelling skills. Only those who witnessed the scene know that you were simply in the right place at the right time.
items.name: Count Harebourg Frozen Shield

items.description: Carrying this prestigious horned shield, you'll feel like a fierce yet noble beast, ready to charge at your opponents to defend your territory! Just be careful not to go charging headfirst into a wall, because the horns will stay stuck in it.
items.name: Royal Mastogob Shield

items.description: Rumour has it that the Celestial Bearbarian's abdomen is very strong and resistant to attacks – just perfect as a shield! But you know what they say about rumours...
items.name: Celestial Bearbarian Shield

items.description: The thick block of ice around this piwi protects it from the wintery cold of Frigost.
items.name: Permafrosty Piwi

items.description: Few creatures can boast as many surprising qualities as the permafrosty gobball. Did you know, for example, that it withstands high temperatures but can't handle the cold? Even more surprising is that when skies are clear, it sometimes hums little ditties about sailors. It has more quirks than can be counted, and as an adventuring companion, it can sometimes be hard to figure out. Nevertheless, it's a faithful steed and its cool coat makes it a very delightful ally in the Ohwymi desert.
items.name: Permafrosty Gobball

items.description: With this thick hood on your head, you definitely won't catch cold. Just make sure you don't get caught by the Count's servants, as that'll probably be a lot harder to recover from.
items.name: Permafrost Resident Hood

items.description: When you live in Frigost, it's best to dress for the weather. This comfortable Mastogob-hair cape will be your strongest ally against the island's icy winds.
items.name: Permafrost Resident Cape

items.description: If you're ever caught in a snowstorm, hold this shield in front of your face. It will keep the snow and wind out of your eyes, and even light the path ahead of you. It doesn't tell time, however.
items.name: Permafrost Resident Shield

items.description: Both resistant and waterproof, this Frigostian outfit is equipped with an integrated heating system that can run on battery power alone for several days. The strong rope included with it should also make it easier to climb the Asparah Gorge or the steep slopes of Mount Scauldron.
items.name: Permafrost Resident Costume

items.description: To venture onto Frigost Island, you've got to have a good head on your shoulders. These should hold it in place pretty well.
items.name: Permafrost Resident Shoulder Pads

items.description: This young dragon may look cute now, but wait until you see its adult form.
items.name: Groug

items.description: Though once very small and not particularly ferocious, this terrifying adult black dragon is now an ideal steed to sow terror and chaos wherever you go.
items.name: Grougalo

items.description: With this draconic helmet, your enemies will look death in the eye while you see the world through rose-coloured glasses.
items.name: Black Dragon's Terror

items.description: This dragonskin cape will protect you from blasts of flame, but not from your own bad karma.
items.name: Black Dragon Finery

items.description: This little dragon still attached to its egg is a perfect defence against anyone who gets too close.
items.name: Black Dragon's Mistrust

items.description: These extremely tough dragon scales will let you absorb all kinds of physical attacks. However, they will not protect your fragile ego from verbal attacks.
items.name: Black Dragon Scales

items.description: These intimidating horns should quickly discourage your less courageous opponents.
items.name: Black Dragon Horns

items.description: This machine in the form of an owl seems to be linked to the power of the Eliacube, unless it's the Eliacube itself...
items.name: Eliaboo

items.description: This machine in the form of a coolwolf seems to be linked to the power of the Eliacube, unless it's the Eliacube itself...
items.name: Elialoo

items.description: This dazzling mask could make you a beacon in the night, or a destroyer of worlds.
items.name: Eliacube Hood

items.description: This cape seems to be made not of cloth, but of the very fabric from which the dimensions are woven.
items.name: Eliacube Cape

items.description: This mysterious portal seems to be connected to another dimension. While it's very handy for causing any projectiles fired your way to disappear without a trace, be careful not to step on it by mistake – no one knows where it leads...
items.name: Eliacube Portal

items.description: This armour, flooded with a constant flow of Wakfu, grants phenomenal power to its wearer – as long as they're able to control it.
items.name: Eliacube Costume

items.description: Are your shoulders broad enough to bear the immense powers of the Eliacube? Only time will tell.
items.name: Eliacube Shoulder Pads

items.description: If you're a little bit mad but are still able to keep a cool head, this helmet is for you.
items.name: Harebourg's Chilblains

items.description: As the proud owner of a chtigredon with the warmest, silkiest fur he'd ever seen, Harebourg quickly realised that his pet was shedding a ridiculous amount of hair. He pragmatically decided to make it into capes for the harsh Frigostian winter.
items.name: Harebourg Tippet

items.description: They say that the Sinistro frozen in this shield stopped working, thus stopping the passage of time along with it. As if stopping this metronome from ticking would have the power to freeze time. A heresy that most any Xelor will advise you to reject.
items.name: Harebourg's Frozen Rampart

items.description: When you're a count, what really counts is the image you project. You need to account for people's perceptions and find advisors you can count on, because a count counts for nothing without his people. But don't count yourself out, because by all accounts, what counts most for counts is to always look your finest.
items.name: Harebourg Attire

items.description: The paradoxical thing about this pet is that it's creation was inspired by the future. But when the model is only invented years after the copy that was used to create the original, who can say which one is authentic? And that sums up Paradoxine in a nutshell.
items.name: Paradoxine

items.description: This petsmount is the offspring of a Sabredon and a Chtigress that Harebourg took in. It's kept its father's great resistance to the cold and his beastial nature, while preserving its mother's agility. Domesticated now, it's become a faitful and devoted steed.
items.name: Chtigredon

items.description: Neutral and sober, these shoulder pads will give you both style and elegance.
items.name: Panache Shoulder Pads

items.description: Once you've donned the Karnaval cape and Karnaval headdress, if you think your look is lacking a few feathers, these wings should do the trick.
items.name: Karnaval Wings

items.description: This shield is useless at deflecting blows, but if you shake it, the way its feathers move will hypnotise your opponent into a jiggle. Bow meows are also especially fond of it.
items.name: Karnaval Shield

items.description: Mum and her whole brood are out and about! It's a veritable symphony of babbling, singing, tweeting and chirping. Woe be to those who try to clip their wings... One peck isn't so bad, but four at a time will start to do some real damage...
items.name: Tofoone Tribe

items.description: This headgear will grant you great powers of persuasion. Everyone you talk to will find themselves unable to refuse anything you ask, even their favourite treat.
items.name: Dauge Headgear

items.description: Unlike Dustoro, this petsmount can do perfect cartwheels and is the envy of even the most experienced athletes. He makes travel smooth and carefree... that is, until he hears music. All it takes is a few notes, and he'll have you up on your feet and be ready to perform one of his choreographed routines.
items.name: Keakop

items.description: When a Sky Knight dies, their soul is reborn as a Soulflame. Their new role is to guide adventurers and grant them the bravery they built up during a lifetime of danger.
items.name: Soulflame

items.description: The Pegallop is often described as equally majestic and stubborn. You'll have to rub it up the right way if you want it to obey you. Don't forget that with one kick, it can send you flying, which is all the more risky when you've got a flying steed.
items.name: Pegallop

items.description: Few have ever seen this lance and survived it. It is said to come down from the sky like lightning, and supposedly, it's only when you feel blood running down your body that you realise you were its target.
items.name: Sky Knight Lance

items.description: With its Pegallop-feather stuffing, this shield can be used as a pillow, should you fancy taking a little nap while on a journey between the clouds.
items.name: Sky Knight Aegis

items.description: The hardest thing about being a champion is staying a champion. Luckily, that's just what this armour is for!
items.name: Champion Armour

items.description: Shoulders straight and head held high – that's the true champion's attitude!
items.name: Champion Shoulder Pads

items.description: This shield is as hard as Kharnotaurus's skull, providing ample protection from enemy attacks. But if you're looking for an accessory to protect your head from getting conked, you should probably keep looking.
items.name: Kharnoshield

items.description: This shield is completely covered with Rac Queen webs. Guaranteed to catch your opponent by surprise when they go in for an uppercut and end up with a shield stuck to their forearm. Take advantage of their confusion to gain the upper hand.
items.name: Racshield

items.description: When you set these glasses on your nose, it's like seeing life through a filter. You'll start pouting like the famous Bella Porch and you'll feel a sudden urge to dance to intoxicating sounds. If you look around you, everyone else seems to be caught up in the same mania. Don't wear them for too long or you may become disconnected from reality.
items.name: Toctik Headgear

items.description: Demon I is not only the youngest Demon of the Hours, he's also the most intelligent.
items.name: Demon I Cloak

items.description: As the result of a bet whose details have been lost to the mists of time, the elegant Demon XIX had to hand over his precious horns to his greatest – yet also smallest – rival: Demon I. As for I's original horns, no one remembers what became of them.
items.name: Demon I Horns

items.description: Given by I himself to the most cunning gladiators, this shield will gain you the respect of the Outerworld demons.
items.name: Demon I Shield

items.description: This scarf will perfectly conceal your contemptuous sneer when you successfully dupe your rivals.
items.name: Demon I Scarf

items.description: Demon I is not only the youngest Demon of the Hours, he's also the most intelligent.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon I Cloak

items.description: As the result of a bet whose details have been lost to the mists of time, the elegant Demon XIX had to hand over his precious horns to his greatest – yet also smallest – rival: Demon I. As for I's original horns, no one remembers what became of them.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon I Horns

items.description: Given by I himself to the most cunning gladiators, this shield will gain you the respect of the Outerworld demons.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon I Shield

items.description: This scarf will perfectly conceal your contemptuous sneer when you successfully dupe your rivals.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon I Scarf

items.description: A Boon just for you?! Who would've thought this fluffy companion could ever be yours? This four-legged stuffed toy is adorable from every angle, but it's also a huge ally. During the day, it'll disorient your enemies, gaining their sympathy with but a look; at night, it'll comfort you after a long day, letting you nuzzle against its soft fur.
items.name: Original Boon

items.description: According to Pandawa tailors, this hat is only for those who are like a ray of sunshine. If you just like catching some rays, that should also do the trick.
items.name: Raydi Hat

items.description: They say that the way the bamboo milk inside this basket is fermented makes it radiant, especially at night.
items.name: Raydi Basket

items.description: With this radiant kimono, you'll shine as brightly as the sun. Expect your friends from southern Pandala to take notice, whether out of admiration or sheer amazement. Perhaps it's the light, perhaps it's a trick of the mind... or perhaps it's just one bottle too many with some magic herbs thrown in.
items.name: Raydi Kimono

items.description: With this armour, you'll feel worthy of taking part in Iop's festivities.
items.name: Savara Armour

items.description: With these shoulder pads, you'll feel worthy of taking part in Iop's festivities.
items.name: Savara Shoulder Pads

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shoulder pads.
items.name: Livitinem Shoulder Pads

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate costumes.
items.name: Livitinem Costume

items.description: The downside of having nine lives is that you have to go through early childhood every time you're reincarnated. This Kerubaby may seem a bit grumpy at times, but try to understand – this is the ninth time he's tried to stop using his dummy, and he still can't do it!
items.name: Kerubaby

items.description:
Is old meat too tough for you to chew on? Are you ready to dish out carnage so you can feast on a mythical creature's succulent flesh? Is Karn your idol?
There's no doubt about it – you're a born hunter-eater, and this uniform will look great on you!
items.name: Hunter-Eater Uniform

items.description: Who would've thought this kind of machine would be created in the Dofus Era? One thing's for sure: every era sees the emergence of genius inventors who can revolutionise the world. What will the future look like? What inventions will tomorrow bring? How will technology shape the World of Twelve?
items.name: Exo SKLTN 2X25

items.description: Machine operators are usually vulnerable in the chest area, which is why they are strongly advised to wear this strong yet lightweight body armour.
items.name: Safety Armour

items.description: This mask ensures optimal protection when using an Exo SKLTN 2X25. You no longer need to worry about the dust you kick up when you run or the smell of sweat coming from your machine.
items.name: Safety Mask

items.description: This little dragoturklet dreams of celebrating Kwismas, but first, it needs to avoid becoming the main dish of Skank Hivin.
items.name: Kwismas Dragoturklet

items.description: This shield is proof that you can hold your own against striches, though it doesn't exactly fly high.
items.name: Strichield

items.description: To be in the bestial cult, you need the proper attire.
items.name: Bestial Cult Attire

items.description: No one knows what animal these skulls come from, but members of the bestial cult consider them highly important.
items.name: Bestial Cult Shoulder Pads

items.description: They say the feathers on this cloak make the wearer lighter, but it won't necessarily give you wings.
items.name: Bestial Cult Finery

items.description: Wearing this skull will remind you of where you came from and how you'll end up.
items.name: Bestial Cult Skull

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shoulder pads.
items.name: Parasymbic Shoulder Pads

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate costumes.
items.name: Parasymbic Costume

items.description: As naughty as a little crobak, but with more style.
items.name: Naughty Little Crobacillus

items.description: This costume is the combination for the perfect charlatan.
items.name: Crobacillus Costume

items.description: Its feathers are so soft and light, you won't feel that weight on your shoulders any more.
items.name: Crobacillus Shoulder Pads

items.description: This cloak will make you feel like you've sprouted wings.
items.name: Crobacillus Feather-Cloak

items.description: This mask keeps you safe from spittle, plus you can eat with it on.
items.name: Crobacillus Beak-Mask

items.description: If anyone tries to criticise you, at last you can bare your claws.
items.name: Crobacillus Talon-Shield

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shoulder pads.
items.name: Shushivin Shoulder Pads

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate costumes.
items.name: Shushivin Costume

items.description: When you're feeling sad, it knows how to comfort you. The small Elante is simply irresistible.
items.name: Small Elante

items.description: This little machine is here to play with you. It has all the time in the world for you.
items.name: F.R.A.N.K.L.1.N.

items.description: Deep within the earth, this drheller – amalgamated with a rare stone called bismuth – drills prolifically. With its keen sense of direction, it easily finds its way around the mazelike cuttings, which may well be an invaluable skill when navigating a labyrinth, but one that pales in comparison to its kindness.
items.name: Drhelmuth

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shoulder pads.
items.name: Alyverol Shoulder Pads

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate costumes.
items.name: Alyverol Costume

items.description: This Gargandydoo is your new boo. Don't neglect it, whatever you do. Give it lots of snuggles, and it'll loooove you!
items.name: Gargandydoo

items.description:
"Gargandy-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo.
Gargandy-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo.
Gargandy-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo.
Gargandydoo!"
— This Gargandydoo's last owner, equally disturbed
items.name: Disturbed Gargandydoo

items.description: A Gargandycutie is basically still your big sweet Gargandydoo boo.
items.name: Gargandycutie

items.description: It's said that a Gargandycutie accepts no owner.
items.name: Disturbed Gargandycutie

items.description: Were these skulls stolen or made from scratch? Only Demon II can answer in the blink of an eye.
items.name: Demon II Shoulder Pads

items.description: Demon II collects all sorts of faces, but she never reveals her own. Sometimes she uses this shield to muddy the waters even more.
items.name: Demon II Shield

items.description: It seems that this cloak has eyes and ears, taking note of every detail of what's happening around its wearer. As a result, it may remind you at any time of either your opponents' shocked faces, or the suspicious noises coming from under your quilt. Fortunately for you, it doesn't seem to have a nose.
items.name: Demon II Cloak

items.description: With this mask, you can make people think you're Demon II. No one can prove you're not, since nobody knows what she really looks like. But be careful – she won't be too happy if she finds out you've stolen her identity...
items.name: Demon II Mask

items.description: Were these skulls stolen or made from scratch? Only Demon II can answer in the blink of an eye.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon II Shoulder Pads

items.description: With this mask, you can make people think you're Demon II. No one can prove you're not, since nobody knows what she really looks like. But be careful – she won't be too happy if she finds out you've stolen her identity...
items.name: Many-Hued Demon II Mask

items.description: It seems that this cloak has eyes and ears, taking note of every detail of what's happening around its wearer. As a result, it may remind you at any time of either your opponents' shocked faces, or the suspicious noises coming from under your quilt. Fortunately for you, it doesn't seem to have a nose.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon II Cloak

items.description: Demon II collects all sorts of faces, but she never reveals her own. Sometimes she uses this shield to muddy the waters even more.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon II Shield

items.description:
"Come with me, the time is right.
There's no better team.
Arm in arm, we'll win the fight.
It's always been our dream."
— A travel agent waxing poetic about their enormeow
items.name: Travel Enormeow

items.description: Life's like a road that you travel on, and this bow meow is a steadfast companion on a travel agent's journey.
items.name: Travel Bow Meow

items.description: When you have this shield, it all comes full circle.
items.name: Travel Agent Shield

items.description: Travel agents who wear this cloak can creep under doors, so stupid and perfect. They do it again and again and again and again...
items.name: Travel Agent Cloak

items.description: With this hood on, travel agents will come running to you in the cold, cold night.
items.name: Travel Agent Hood

items.description:
"I'm sittin' on the dock of the harbour,
Watching the tide roll away from my shoulder armour."
— A travel agent resting at Madrestam Harbour
items.name: Travel Agent Shoulder Pads

items.description: Wearing this costume, they fly in all degrees, to anywhere they please. That's how you recognise a travel agent.
items.name: Travel Agent Costume

items.description: This costume will make you look like a Dimensional Voyager.
items.name: Voyager Costume

items.description: This costume has the features of the one they call "the devourer". It's quite simply unheard of.
items.name: Gargandyuan Costume

items.description: This shield is soft yet resistant to claw attacks.
items.name: Gargandyuan Shield

items.description: Instead of leaving with your tail between your legs, you'll have one on your back.
items.name: Gargandyuan Tail

items.description: With these horns, you won't have to use that one gesture at hardcore concerts.
items.name: Gargandyuan Horns

items.description: This wand can slice anything that moves.
items.name: Gargandyuan Wand

items.description: This staff is handy for skewering a few hunks of meat.
items.name: Gargandyuan Staff

items.description: The blade on this sword is very sharp. What more is there to say?
items.name: Gargandyuan Sword

items.description: The string on this bow is so strong, it could slice you if you're not careful...
items.name: Gargandyuan Bow

items.description: These daggers are actually two miniature swords, but they're just as sharp as the original version.
items.name: Gargandyuan Daggers

items.description: If someone provokes you, just bury them.
items.name: Gargandyuan Shovel

items.description: With this weapon you can really hammer a point if someone tries to disagree with you.
items.name: Gargandyuan Hammer

items.description: You may be axing, "What's so special about this weapon?" Why not find out for yourself?
items.name: Gargandyuan Axe

items.description: This bag was crafted with a fragment from Gargandyas's Temple, but keep it to yourself. The Rhoarim would be all too eager to skin you alive if they found out!
items.name: Osavora Osatchel

items.description: This shield was crafted from one of Gargandyas's scales, which makes it incredibly durable.
items.name: Osavora Shield

items.description: The horns that adorn this headgear will make you see through an Osamodas's eyes. They can also act as weapons if you unleash your bestial side!
items.name: Osavora Horns

items.description: When you equip this shield, you'll feel like someone's giving you the evil eye.
items.name: Koutoulou Shield

items.description: This shield doesn't have any defensive capability, but at least you've got a change of clothes if you have an accident.
items.name: Tengu Shield

items.description: Like all other babies, this one might produce lots of tears. Watch out for floods.
items.name: Baby Ogrest

items.description: Fill your head with dreams by putting this headgear on.
items.name: Dream Fountain Headgear

items.description: This cloak will make you want to fly in your dreams.
items.name: Dream Fountain Cloak

items.description: This shield can act like a dreamcatcher.
items.name: Dream Fountain Shield

items.description: If you're always daydreaming, this costume is perfect for you.
items.name: Dreamer Costume

items.description: With this costume, you can remember certain dreams you had previously buried in the deepest parts of your memory.
items.name: Paradoxical Costume

items.description: When adventurers see you, they scream in terror.
items.name: Nightmarish Costume

items.description: When created, this shield was placed under a powerful spell intended to exponentially increase the oratory talents of whoever carries it. However, a slight grammatical mistake in the incantation of the spell means that its power is only activated when it is used to create chaos. In short, it's the perfect shield for family gatherings.
items.name: Shield O'Discord

items.description: The events organised by Zi have become so popular that he gains new supporters each time. So, he decided to create this cloak so that each generous backer could wear his colours and raise the visibility of his project. You should wear this cloak with pride, because it proves your generosity to other adventurers in the World of Twelve.
items.name: Zi Cloak

items.description: It seems that Osamodas sometimes uses his tail as a whip. Now you can do the same.
items.name: Osamodas Attributes

items.description: Unless your partner enjoys getting scratched in the face, they can forget about kissing you on the neck as long as you're wearing this necklace!
items.name: Sacrier Necklace

items.description: This element-proof breastplate ensures optimal protection.
items.name: Huppermage Breastplate

items.description: Even though these arms make you look like a master of time, there's no point in asking you the time, because you won't know.
items.name: Xelor Sleeves

items.description: Bugs won't bother you any more with this helmet.
items.name: Test-a-Helm

items.description: With these demon feet, you'll stomp out the competition.
items.name: Demon III Feet

items.description: With these demon feet, you'll stomp out the competition.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon III Feet

items.description: This dial shows how much time Demon III's conquests have left before they're replaced. At least it's honest.
items.name: Demon III Dial

items.description: This dial shows how much time Demon III's conquests have left before they're replaced. At least it's honest.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon III Dial

items.description: A real charmer and a heartbreaker, Demon III is all the rage in the Outerworld. It's hard to say you'll be as successful with this helmet on your head, in the Outerworld or elsewhere.
items.name: Demon III Helmet

items.description: A real charmer and a heartbreaker, Demon III is all the rage in the Outerworld. It's hard to say you'll be as successful with this helmet on your head, in the Outerworld or elsewhere.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon III Helmet

items.description: This cloak can withstand the ravages of time, but it won't protect you from the ravages of love.
items.name: Demon III Cloak

items.description: This cloak can withstand the ravages of time, but it won't protect you from the ravages of love.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon III Cloak

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate hats.
items.name: Dreamalive Hat

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate capes.
items.name: Dreamalive Cape

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shields.
items.name: Dreamalive Shield

items.description: This polymorphic item establishes a predatory or symbiotic relationship with inanimate shoulder pads.
items.name: Dreamalive Shoulder Pads

items.description: Don't worry – this pet would rather break your opponents' knees than break your dreams.
items.name: Pallor Din

items.description: This pet will give you the strength to face all your nightmares.
items.name: Sithy Dweller

items.description: Use your petsmount to take your dreams all the way.
items.name: Onirion

items.description: You won't have to run away from your nightmares, because this petsmount will scare them away for you.
items.name: Nefarion

items.description: Much like memories and regrets, dead leaves can be gathered up in great piles... or soar like wings on the wind.
items.name: Autumn Leaves

items.description: Check out this absolute unit of a rat. Impressive, no?
items.name: Bacterat

items.description: With this wig, you too can be as seductive and narcissistic as Demon IV.
items.name: Demon IV Wig

items.description: When unfolded and worn as a cape, there's something deeply disturbing about this dress... For once, the best way to intimidate your enemies is to turn your back on them.
items.name: Demon IV Dress

items.description: The skull on this shield belonged to a gladiator that Demon IV found attractive. So you should probably be safe.
items.name: Demon IV Shield

items.description: Both your fights and your tender embraces just got a lot more prickly.
items.name: Demon IV Necklace

items.description: With this wig, you too can be as seductive and narcissistic as Demon IV.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon IV Wig

items.description: When unfolded and worn as a cape, there's something deeply disturbing about this dress... For once, the best way to intimidate your enemies is to turn your back on them.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon IV Dress

items.description: The skull on this shield belonged to a gladiator that Demon IV found attractive. So you should probably be safe.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon IV Shield

items.description: Both your fights and your tender embraces just got a lot more prickly.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon IV Necklace

items.description: These shoulder pads are so bright, you've gotta wear shades.
items.name: Adestra Shoulder Pads

items.description: Instead of lying around at home, go for a walk with Deeum and seize some flowers.
items.name: Deeum

items.description: You think this cloak is cool, therefore it is.
items.name: Airgo Cloak

items.description: To be or not to be? That's a good question.
items.name: Summ Shield

items.description: A wise bird doesn't pee into the wind.
items.name: Carpay

items.description: When people look at you, do you think they're thinking the same thing? Or perhaps like you, they don't think at all.
items.name: Cogito Crown

items.description: With this costume, you too can shine bright and reach for the stars.
items.name: Sickiture Costume

items.description:
Is old meat too tough for you to chew on? Are you ready to dish out carnage so you can feast on a mythical creature's succulent flesh? Is Karn your idol?
There's no doubt about it – you're a born hunter-eater, and this uniform will look great on you!
items.name: Hunter-Eater Uniform

items.description: When your enemies see this amulet around your smooth, slender neck they'll think you're actually as hairy as the YeCh'Ti, which will frighten the living daylights out of them.
items.name: YeCh'Ti Amulet

items.description: This shield is a relic that holds Goultard's wonderful broken sword. You might be wondering how that Iop could have been so powerful despite his broken weapon. You're right, but that question will scramble your brain less than this one: how powerful could he have become if the sword weren't broken?
items.name: Goultard's Shield

items.description: The Mechasm technology used to design this shield seems as mysterious as the people who created it. When you wear it, you feel as if someone's watching you... as if you'll never be alone again.
items.name: Lokus Shield

items.description: This cape will definitely make you look stylish as it flaps in the wind in the desert. The one and only condition for you to equip it is that you must be completely bare-chested underneath it. If you're going to look like Goultard, you might as well go all-out. Just remember to bring something for your sunburn.
items.name: Goultard's Cape

items.description: If you suddenly get the impression that there's someone following you around, then you've probably fallen prey to this helmet's power to make its wearer think that shadows are alive. Hey, a shock to the system might finally cure your sciaphobia!
items.name: Shadow Helmet

items.description: Certain adventurers claim that Bearendizer, in order to become the most powerful of all the Bearbarians, sold his soul to Djaul and, since then, his physical incarnation has been controlled by the bee on his shoulder, Actahive. This is only a rumour, though, and they're probably just trying to justify the fact that they're not very muscular.
items.name: Bearendizer's Belt

items.description:
In mastering the ancestral art of Roshambo, you have finally come to understand the profound meaning of the expression "a rolling Rock crushes no Paper".

(Place these boots over a pair of already-equipped boots to change their appearance.)
items.name: Rando Geta

items.description: After outwitting Gein's double, sidestepping his traps and foiling his invisibility gimmick, you really deserve this skull as a symbol of your clear-headedness. You should probably hide it if you ever come across the real Gein, of course, as it'd be a shame to be stripped of your title so soon.
items.name: Skullcrasher

items.description: Mix new technology with traditional methods and you end up with the Scampiscuba Helmet. This jazzed-up diving headgear will allow a Scampihorse to disappear down into the deepest, darkest depths of Sufokia for days on end for a little "alone time". As for you, you can use it as a scuba-diving mask, but please try to stay afloat. We wouldn't want to have to call the rescue team out again.
items.name: Scampiscuba Helmet

items.description: The expression "be careful no one gives you the evil eye" takes on its full meaning with this shield... Except in your case, you've already been given it.
items.name: Shushield

items.description: Have you always dreamed of being like the brave and handsome Goultard? The illusion be perfect with these flowing locks... if only your odour didn't give you away.
items.name: Goultard's Flowing Locks

items.description: With this petsmount, you can proudly display your guild banner wherever you go.
items.name: Incorporated

items.description: From afar, this tofu could be mistaken for a sinistro.
items.name: Oropo Tofu

items.description: When this tofu needs food, it can travel quite a distance to satisfy its hunger.
items.name: Toross Tofu

items.description: This tofu isn't all black or white. It's also a little blue.
items.name: Qilby Tofu

items.description: Try not to drown your sorrows near this tofu, or else it'll be drowning you in its tears as well.
items.name: Ogrest Tofu

items.description: This vile tofu loathes wasting time.
items.name: Nox Tofu

items.description: Fashioned from a fabric that never wrinkles, it represents your guild's unwavering principles.
items.name: Incorporated Cape

items.description: With this hood, members of a guild can fight under the same banner, masking individuality for the sake of collective identity.
items.name: Incorporated Hood

items.description: Each impact sustained by this shield is an attack absorbed by the entire guild, symbolising the cohesion of its members.
items.name: Incorporated Shield

items.description: This tunic evokes a history of shared resilience and combat. It's the uniform of duty, suited to any and all situations.
items.name: Incorporated Tunic

items.description: These blades symbolise your striking power and speed of execution, qualities that make you a major asset to your guild.
items.name: Incorporated Winged Blades

items.description: When you don this shoulder pad, you take on the legacy, hardship and glory of the entire guild.
items.name: Incorporated Shoulder Pad

items.description: An amazingly soft ring, woven with what seems to be wool from a freshly shorn wild gobball. It attracts a young gobball that will follow you around.
items.name: Woolly Band

items.description: This ring was forged from a super-light alloy and bedecked with freshly fallen tofu feathers (the tofu was probably spooked). It's so light it could fly away. After you equip it, a little tofu will be bound to you.
items.name: Feathery Band

items.description: This ring was carved out of wood from Amakna Forest, its design consisting of tiny prespic peaks. If you wear it, a little prespic will be lured by its beauty.
items.name: Spiny Band

items.description: This ring was made from threads of arachnee silk. When you put it on, you'll attract a harmless little arachnee that follows you around, weaving tiny webs on your items and the back of your boots.
items.name: Silky Band

items.description: This impressively large ring is a fragment of rock that fell from the Crackler Mountains. When you equip it, a young crackrock will accompany you. It'll be the strongest, most loyal sidekick you could wish for.
items.name: Rocky Band

items.description: This helmet is a reward for young fighters who show great promise. So you see, fighting in the mud and biting your opponent's foot or pulling his ear was worth it.
items.name: Bronze Kayteeyay Helm

items.description: This helmet rewards the spectacular feats of the best fighters from among the ordinary rank and file. This gives them a place of pride in all the inns in the World of Twelve.
items.name: Silver Kayteeyay Helm

items.description: This helmet rewards the most tenacious veterans and superb tacticians. The lowest of low blows and most dazzling acts have no secrets for them.
items.name: Gold Kayteeyay Helm

items.description: This cloak is a reward for young fighters who show great promise. So you see, fighting in the mud and biting your opponent's foot or pulling his ear was worth it.
items.name: Bronze Kayteeyay Cape

items.description: This cloak rewards the spectacular feats of the best fighters from among the ordinary rank and file. This gives them a place of pride in all the inns in the World of Twelve.
items.name: Silver Kayteeyay Cape

items.description: This cloak rewards the most tenacious veterans and superb tacticians. The lowest of low blows and most dazzling acts have no secrets for them.
items.name: Gold Kayteeyay Cape

items.description: This headgear serves as an extension of one's thoughts, enabling the wearer to analyse monsters' behaviour, determine the outcome of a battle before it starts, and anticipate more complex attacks.
items.name: Tactician Headgear

items.description: With this cape, you'll finally have eyes in the back of your head so you can see monsters sneaking up behind you.
items.name: Tactician Cape

items.description: They say this shield will whisper in the wearer's ear to warn them of a sneak attack, thereby turning any ambush into a tactical opportunity.
items.name: Tactician Shield

items.description: This wand can slice anything that moves.
items.name: Queen Odasouth Wand

items.description: Let's just say that under this hat, you'll find anything but gifts.
items.name: Kwismas 655 Treetop

items.description: One thing's for sure – you've got a good head on your shoulders. But what in the world do you have on your head?
items.name: Ankegasa

items.description: Don't worry. Someone's watching your six.
items.name: Ankimono

items.description: This shield is more than just protection: it's also a symbol. The symbol of balance, passing time, stability, and a future waiting in the wings. Kind of a big deal, right?!
items.name: Ankarogo

items.description: This little critter seems very cute even though no one knows exactly what it is. One thing is certain, however. Don't touch it unless you want to lose a finger... or two.
items.name: Ankadrak

items.description: Members of the guild of Oni devotees were easy to spot thanks to their masks.
items.name: Oni Devotee Mask

items.description: This veil is the finishing touch for the uniform worn by members of the guild of Oni devotees.
items.name: Oni Devotee Veil

items.description: Members of the guild of Oni devotees aren't afraid of getting hit, especially when they're carrying this shield.
items.name: Oni Devotee Shield

items.description: When a young adventurer went to Pandala Island to complete a population regulation mission, she found the Yokai absolutely adorable, especially the Oni. She therefore decided to start her own guild and force all its members to wear an official uniform. Passing herself off as an Oni was so important to her that history has now forgotten this adventurer's name.
items.name: Oni Devotee Costume

items.description: Oni devotees never go out in public without their full uniform, including these shoulder pads.
items.name: Oni Devotee Shoulder Pads

items.description: No one knows how the Oni devotees managed to tame this creature. All we do know is that this mount is loyal and enables guild members to complete their missions worldwide.
items.name: Onino

items.description: This adorable little ball of fur usually prefers to sleep peacefully in the Oni devotee guild hall, but sometimes it enjoys accompanying its masters.
items.name: Bow Meoni

items.description: Being crowned with such a crown is a great honour in the life of any exploring adventurer. Some even say that if you don't have one by the time you turn 50, you've failed at life.
items.name: Extreme Diadem

items.description: The best adventures require proper preparations! To go the distance, you'll need the right amenities. What did you expect? Adventure also means pooping in the woods...
items.name: Ultimate Kitbag

items.description: With a shield like this one, your adventure will take off... literally! Your opponents will be so charmed by the sight of it that they won't dare strike out of fear of denting it.
items.name: Flyhaway Shield

items.description: You can't quite tell if the look in its eyes is determined or disillusioned... Pro tip: don't tease it to try to figure out which it is! Driven by its passion for the Emerald Dofus, Raptrike strikes hard... and often without warning.
items.name: Raptrike

items.description: This little creature has the annoying habit of escorting you wherever you are: travelling, eating, in bed, even on the toilet! Give it a job to do if you want some peace and quiet.
items.name: Squirelet

items.description: When the falling temperatures drag the leaves down with them, only these antlers remain aloft. A bit like your courage, which wavers even less than the thermometer.
items.name: Winter Antlers

items.description: Dragons tend to ignore mere mortals, but sometimes certain individuals manage to pique the curiosity of these reptiles. When wearing this cape, you can be in this exclusive club.
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Cape

items.description: Many people dream of becoming a dragon. Until this wish is somehow granted, this headgear lets you pretend to be one.
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Mask

items.description: This shield is actually a real dragon's scale.
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Shield

items.description: With these wings, you'll be completely unflappable.
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Wings

items.description: You'll look smoking hot in this costume!
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Costume

items.description: To stand shoulder to shoulder with dragons, you need strong shoulders.
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Shoulder Pads

items.description: A symbol of a time long past, this crown gives its wearer the ability to keep a cool head and always make the right decision.
items.name: Ice Lord Crown

items.description: Get ready to bring the axe down on your enemies!
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Axe

items.description: Get ready to bring the hammer down on your enemies!
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Hammer

items.description: Get ready to bury your enemies!
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Shovel

items.description: Get ready to look daggers at your enemies!
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Daggers

items.description: Get ready to pierce the ranks of your enemies!
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Bow

items.description: Get ready to cut down your enemies!
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Sword

items.description: The Ice Lord goes nowhere without his cape. He always attaches a sword – received as a pledge of allegiance from the fearsome Ice Knight – to it.
items.name: Ice Lord Cape

items.description: Get ready to stick it to your enemies!
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Staff

items.description: Get ready to bore your enemies!
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Lance

items.description: Get ready to put a spell on your enemies!
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Wand

items.description: The stalactites hanging from this shield can be ripped off and used as projectiles when the enemy is too far away. Obviously, it's not quite as effective in the summer.
items.name: Ice Lord Shield

items.description: It might not be the same as riding a dragon, but you're certainly not missing out. This creature has endless stamina and will take you to the very depths of the World of Twelve.
items.name: Drak

items.description: With this harness on, your mount should be able to avoid being eaten by a dragon.
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Dragoturkey

items.description: With this harness on, your mount should be able to avoid being eaten by a dragon.
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Seemyool

items.description: With this harness on, your mount should be able to avoid being eaten by a dragon.
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Rhineetle

items.description: This costume was carefully designed to resist the cold without restricting the movement of whoever wears it. It also appears to have the ability to store the magic of a spell that targets it in order to use the spell again at just the right time.
items.name: Ice Lord Costume

items.description: Even though you can't actually grow wings, you'll still feel like a fish in water!
items.name: Foggernaut Wings

items.description: You can now take a disciple under your wing and protect them from dangers that would otherwise prove fatal.
items.name: Feca Wings

items.description: Now, with a flap of your wings you can make projectiles rain down on your adversaries! However, be sure to pick them up afterward.
items.name: Cra Wings

items.description: You can put your name on this necklace so that it can be returned to you in case you misplace it by accident.
items.name: Ecaflip Necklace

items.description: Get ready to cut down your enemies!
items.name: Champion of the Dragons Scythe

items.description: This little dragoone loves gobballs and refuses to devour them. In order to live among them without frightening them, it had the bright idea to wear gobball headgear, and this worked!
items.name: Madreggobball

items.description: There's a persistent legend that centorors steal adventurers' loot at the end of their fights. But actually, they only collect what adventurers leave behind. So don't worry – even with this pet by your side, your loot is completely safe.
items.name: Lilcentor

items.description: Fate won't take you for a fool with this fool's cap. Because the world will seem sunnier with it on. Or maybe... you'll just look funnier.
items.name: Impromptu Mask

items.description: Why the serious face? Are you trying to figure this cape out? It is... like life – fluctuating, agitated, sometimes calm, sometimes wild. In short: unpredictable.
items.name: Double-Luck Mantle

items.description: Brandish your shield with the utmost irreverence and take a stand against waves of sad, hateful comments. A lovely raspberry that will turn tragedy into comedy and send those haters' own spittle back their way!
items.name: Rigged Shield

items.description: This little sea dragon is a lot like coral: the prettier and more colourful it is, the more you should stay away! But... if you really want to try your luck, who are we to stand in your way?
items.name: Aguabi

items.description: You might look a bit horsey with this headband, but that's no reason to have a cavalier attitude.
items.name: Horseman Headband

items.description: With this cloak, luck may smile on you.
items.name: Horseman Cloak

items.description: Thanks to the horseshoe shape of these shoulder pads, they fit all types of shoulders wonderfully, even yours.
items.name: Horseman Shoulder Pads

items.description: You'll be lucky if you manage to block any blows with this shield.
items.name: Horseman Shield

items.description: Being somewhat diminutive of stature, this petsmount is perfect for those who would rather not get on their high horse.
items.name: Gidyup

items.description: Woven at the dawn of time, it has stood the test of time and evolved alongside incarnates. Every crease is a reminder that even time respects legends.
items.name: Quarter-of-a-Century Cape

items.description: Demon V is quite simply Demon XVII's brains. He spends much of his time finding ways and other mnemonic methods to help him compensate for his memory lapses.
items.name: Demon V Ink Pot

items.description: As long as a shopping list, this scroll probably contains valuable information about the secrets of the Outerworld, if you can decipher them.
items.name: Demon V Scroll

items.description: With this demonic pen holder, you can write some killer poetry.
items.name: Demon V Pen Holder

items.description: When you're short of ink or inspiration, these little ink pots are ideal for refilling your ink, but not your inspiration.
items.name: Demon V Shoulder Pads

items.description: Demon V is quite simply Demon XVII's brains. He spends much of his time finding ways and other mnemonic methods to help him compensate for his memory lapses.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon V Ink Pot

items.description: As long as a shopping list, this scroll probably contains valuable information about the secrets of the Outerworld, if you can decipher them.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon V Scroll

items.description: With this demonic pen holder, you can write some killer poetry.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon V Pen Holder

items.description: When you're short of ink or inspiration, these little ink pots are ideal for refilling your ink, but not your inspiration.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon V Shoulder Pads

items.description: Forged in fires of unimaginable heat, the dome of this helmet burns hot and cauterises the wounds it inflicts on your enemies before sending them to Externam. Made by pros for pros.
items.name: Volcahelm

items.description: No one can sneak up on you when you're wearing this cape – it ignites everything it touches! ... Hopefully you're not too attached to your rugs and curtains!
items.name: Capyrolysis

items.description: With this shield, which is the product of lava spewed forth from the bowels of a volcano, you can blaze a trail in your future battles. Just warn your enemies: if you play with fire, you get burned.
items.name: Volwark

items.description: This chubby little dragon has fire in its belly. Which might explain the chubbiness.
items.name: Ignemikling

items.description: This can be used to liven up guild parties where the beer flows a bit too freely and to test you and your more down-to-earth companions' flexibility, all while bystanders cheer you on.
items.name: Incorporated Staff

items.description: You might sometimes feel a bit stung by your closest companions' remarks, but you should really use your spear to promote goodwill and harmony.
items.name: Incorporated Spear

items.description: Great for carving out time to chat with your friends.
items.name: Incorporated Sword

items.description: Your guild has more than one string to its bow, and now you can add your own to it!
items.name: Incorporated Bow

items.description: These two blades are inseparable, kind of like the members of your guild!
items.name: Incorporated Daggers

items.description: This shovel is perfect for treasure hunts with friends.
items.name: Incorporated Shovel

items.description: If you had this hammer, you'd put your heart and soul into serving your guild day and night.
items.name: Incorporated Hammer

items.description: With this guild skin, your dragoturkey will practically become a member of your big family.
items.name: Incorporated Dragoturkey

items.description: With this guild skin, your seemyool will practically become a member of your big family.
items.name: Incorporated Seemyool

items.description: With this guild skin, your rhineetle will practically become a member of your big family.
items.name: Incorporated Rhineetle

items.description: Useful for chopping wood for your community members, and it'll also come in handy for hacking away at monsters when you head out with your companions.
items.name: Incorporated Axe

items.description: With this diadem, you'll be able to spread your wings and achieve your true potential.
items.name: Blazing Diadem of the Phoenix

items.description: When you equip this cape, you'll have a burning desire to take flight.
items.name: Flaming Finery of the Phoenix

items.description: This shield will ignite at the slightest touch. So don't lie down on it. The resulting fire in your belly is not the kind that you want.
items.name: Scorching Shield of the Phoenix

items.description: Why does this fowl beast always make you cry? It's probably because the flames are constantly burning your eyes.
items.name: Roschikkin

items.description: This little Buboulder has more than just smouldering eyes.
items.name: Busmoulder

items.description: This costume is made for those who never give up, even when they're in the line of fire.
items.name: Fireproof Costume of the Phoenix

items.description: Being part of a guild is all about learning to live together despite differing opinions. For the most difficult disagreements, instead of trying to resolve them with a wave of a magic wand, you can just use this wand.
items.name: Incorporated Wand

items.description: Anyone who attacks your guild deserves a good threshing!
items.name: Incorporated Scythe

items.description: You can also kneel on this shield if you need to quickly descend a snowy mountain, whether out of fear for your life or simply for fun.
items.name: Royal Pingwall

items.description: This shield proves you have finally grabbed the bull by the horns.
items.name: Minotarge

items.description: This charming little hairball has a tendency to copy its master's appearance. It mimics them so well that it even copies their questionable choices in colour.
items.name: Chamelefoux

items.description: Wearing this helmet can be a hair-raising experience.
items.name: Supercharged Helmet

items.description: This may reduce your carrying capacity, but it's just like carrying a capacitor!
items.name: Supercharged Shield

items.description: Perfect for frying that chip on your shoulder.
items.name: Supercharged Spaulders

items.description: This will give you the energy to stand with the resistance and charge forward!
items.name: Supercharged Costume

items.description: These will prevent you from remaining static for too long.
items.name: Supercharged Wings

items.description: Whatever you do, don't touch the ends together!
items.name: Supercharged Cape

items.description: This temperamental creature can bite very hard and electrocute its master for no good reason.
items.name: Fulguroskryl

items.description: This creature can move incredibly fast but doesn't seem to want to very often.
items.name: Vypowt

items.description: Is this adorable little pest the offspring of Belladonna's pet, or is it a fake? It doesn't really matter. Don't forget to pet Thistle Bow Meow in the direction of her thorns, or else you might get hurt, which would make her purr with pleasure.
items.name: Thistle Bow Meow

items.description: It is said that although the Minilodon's courage matches its fury, it is surely the bravest creature in the abysses. Follow its example and scare off your inner coward to finally become the adventurer you've always dreamed of being.
items.name: Minilodon

items.description: The birds are returning from their long migration, the flowers are timidly starting to bloom... spring is definitely here! And now you can wear the first leaves of nature's rebirth.
items.name: Spring Wings

items.description: This dragon won't hesitate to spew flames on anything that isn't blue.
items.name: Drakarmine

items.description: Once you're riding this wolf, you'll no longer be afraid to aim for the title.
items.name: Solupunary

items.description: This dragon's name could be pronounced a few different ways. One thing is sure: underneath the armour, this creature is a big softie.
items.name: Hangon

items.description: This creature is endearing yet fearsome. It won't hesitate to pierce anything that gets in its way.
items.name: Pepsykins

items.description: This costume will make you shine like gold while putting a pep in your step.
items.name: Peps Costume

items.description: These shoulder pads are a gem.
items.name: Peps Shoulder Pads

items.description: With these tools, you'll be able to unearth all the nuggets in the world.
items.name: Peps Gimlets

items.description: If you can't find a job, you can at least wear this costume to encourage those in the workforce.
items.name: Joblife Costume

items.description: Want to show you've been doing well for yourself since you found a job? These shoulder pads are just the thing.
items.name: Joblife Shoulder Pads

items.description: Will having wings give you a job? You can try to answer this question, but it won't change your situation either way.
items.name: Joblife Wings

items.description: The stone plating and bandages protecting VI make him resistant to the test of time.
items.name: Demon VI Cloak

items.description: The stone plating and bandages protecting VI make him resistant to the test of time.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon VI Cloak

items.description: As a cardinal demon, VI spends the majority of his time looking towards the south. With his head held high, his many ploys have but one goal: bring down his main rival, Midnight.
items.name: Demon VI Headgear

items.description: As a cardinal demon, VI spends the majority of his time looking towards the south. With his head held high, his many ploys have but one goal: bring down his main rival, Midnight.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon VI Headgear

items.description: His eloquence, his manners and his sense of strategy make VI a fearsome opponent.
items.name: Demon VI Shield

items.description: His eloquence, his manners and his sense of strategy make VI a fearsome opponent.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon VI Shield

items.description: These shoulder pads will no doubt give you a more stately demeanour, almost as stately as Demon VI.
items.name: Demon VI Shoulder Pads

items.description: These shoulder pads will no doubt give you a more stately demeanour, almost as stately as Demon VI.
items.name: Many-Hued Demon VI Shoulder Pads

items.description: With a collar like this, you'll go down as a legend for sure!
items.name: Iop Collar

items.description: Anyone who wears a heart on their belt most certainly smiles at life. Giving thanks, singing and dancing! In one word, it's simply love.
items.name: Eniripsa Belt

items.description: A torso with so many facets, you'd think it feels emotions... It tends to grimace when you get it near water.
items.name: Masqueraider Torso

items.description: They can explode without their owner's consent. Keep your eye on this.
items.name: Rogue Shoulder Pads

items.description: It provides effective protection from anything that might fall from the sky.
items.name: Exterminator Headgear

items.description: How you interpret the image on it probably says a lot about you...
items.name: Exterminator Shield

items.description: Any exterminator worth their salt ought to have sharp things all over their outfit – and that includes their shoulder pads!
items.name: Exterminator Shoulder Pads

items.description: That'll make your friends think: "don't stand so close to him..."
items.name: Exterminator Costume

items.description: Not only do they cut cleanly – they look stylish too.
items.name: Exterminator Wings

items.description: Don't be fooled by its sharp protrusions, because there's nothing aerodynamic about this cape, and it'll just weigh you down underwater. However, the person who designed it swore blind that it would wipe out bad taste. That's the next best thing, right?
items.name: Exterminator Cape

items.description: It'll take you sssssimply everywhere.
items.name: Sssssteed

items.description: It'll always follow in your footssssstepsssss.
items.name: Plisssssken

items.description: A single piece of wood crafted from the crown of a thousand-year-old tree, this unique headgear, solid and sharp as stone, is passed down from Terrakourial to adventurers who revere him.
items.name: Apex of Destiny

items.description: This cape can withstand the ravages of time along with any traitorous blows – especially if those traitorous blows involve carving a heart around a pair of initials.
items.name: Protective Bark

items.description: This shield disorients your aggressors: they'll think they're hitting it straight on, but they're actually so far away... As far as an earthworm from the treetop! And when it finally comes down on them, it'll be like an earthquake.
items.name: Earthly Rift

items.description: Among the trees and muddy earth, this wyrmling feels like a fish in water. Who knew muck could be so cosy?
items.name: Tirrakou

items.description: If you struggle to keep your head above water, then this mask is perfect for you!
items.name: Chasm Diving Mask

items.description: Yes, diving capes are a thing. They don't make you swim any faster, but they do offer worthwhile extra protection from the Chasm's predators.
items.name: Chasm Diving Cape

items.description: Any resemblance to the horrid creatures you might encounter in the ocean depths is purely coincidental.
items.name: Chasm Lanternshield

items.description: Skin-tight, shiny and waterproof, this suit is made for exploring the unfathomable depths of Sufokia. Please note that it should also work just fine for certain adult-themed nights. But in that case, be careful with the tentacles wrapped around the belt.
items.name: Chasm Diving Suit

items.description: These fin-shaped shoulder pads will make you glide through the water when you need to swim for your life at the sight of the monsters haunting the Chasm.
items.name: Chasm Fins

items.description: How did this Tiwabbit Wosungwee end up here? At any rate, he seems to be safe in this little jellyfish-shaped bathyscaphe.
items.name: Jelliwabbit

items.description:
Among seahorses living in the abysses, the males carry the young. While this might be a surprising trait, it's not actually that uncommon in the animal kingdom.
These creatures also make for brilliant underwater steeds, because only octodolls and mermaids can match their speed.
items.name: Abysseahorse

items.description: Isn't it cute?
items.name: Tofookie

items.description: You might not fly very high with these wings, but one thing's for sure – they'll stop you from sinking.
items.name: Floating Wings

items.description: This swimsuit is perfect for spending time in glorious sunshine at the seaside. The usual warnings apply: take care in the intense heat, make sure you eat enough and drink plenty of fluids to reduce the risk of fatigue, headaches, dizziness, nausea and speaking gibberish.
items.name: Beachalive Swimsuit

items.description: An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. You'll level everything in your path... with a smile.
items.name: Skale the Multimeka

items.description: This Multimeka is the perfect weapon for an exterminator because it can crush anything in its path like common insects.
items.name: Beelzebug the Multimeka

items.description: This visor can withstand impacts and act as gills. Just don't forget to take it off when you fancy a bite to eat.
items.name: Skale Submersible Visor

items.description: Wearing this and looking like a scaraleaf, others won't be able to hold a candle to you. You're not the pest – it's those who'll try to get in your way.
items.name: Beelzebug Burning Mask

items.description: This blade made of shark teeth can cut through anything and anyone. Some people even say that Skale used it to slice the sea in two.
items.name: Skale Bluewave Blade

items.description: With its molten metal, Beelzebug used this bident to scorify opponents and allies alike.
items.name: Beelzebug Molten Bident

items.description: This suit is perfect for fishing for fingerlings.
items.name: Skale Amphibious Suit

items.description: This suit can withstand extremely high and low temperatures alike. It also helps sustain and focus its wearer's zeal.
items.name: Beelzebug Fireproof Suit

items.description: These hydrodynamic fins might even let you move around like a shark in the sea.
items.name: Skale Fins

items.description: Just as enduring as they are fiery, these shoulder pads are a reflection of Beelzebug's fury.
items.name: Beelzebug Carapaces

items.description: Who would've expected such staying power 25 years ago?
items.name: Krosmoz 25th Anniversary Eye Patch

items.description: Settle in, wrap yourself in this cape and listen to the wondrous tales of the Krosmoz.
items.name: Krosmoz 25th Anniversary Cape

items.description: There's no shortage of epic battles in the Krosmoz, so it's wise to always have a shield at hand.
items.name: Krosmoz 25th Anniversary Shield

items.description: Flutter from quest to quest in search of those coveted Dofus.
items.name: Krosmoz 25th Anniversary Wings

items.description: Only the bravest explorers of the Krosmoz are worthy enough to wear this costume.
items.name: Krosmoz 25th Anniversary Costume

items.description: The weight of the Krosmoz is on your shoulders.
items.name: Krosmoz 25th Anniversary Shoulder Pads

items.description: This axe seems to have been forged using Ignemikal's breath.
items.name: Axe of the Reckless

items.description: This scythe seems to have been forged using Ignemikal's breath.
items.name: Scythe of the Reckless

items.description: This hammer seems to have been forged using Grougalorasalar's breath.
items.name: Hammer of the Ashen

items.description: This shovel seems to have been forged using Terrakourial's breath.
items.name: Shovel of the Muddy

items.description: This lance seems to have been forged using Terrakourial's breath.
items.name: Lance of the Muddy

items.description: These daggers seem to have been forged using Aguabrial's breath.
items.name: Daggers of the Flowing

items.description: This wand seems to have been carved under Aguabrial's sharp eye.
items.name: Wand of the Flowing

items.description: This bow seems to have been carved under Aerafal's sharp eye.
items.name: Bow of the Windy

items.description: This staff seems to have been carved under Aerafal's sharp eye.
items.name: Staff of the Windy

items.description: This sword seems to have been forged using Dardondakal's breath.
items.name: Sword of the Wise

items.description: Welcome to Krosmozic Park...
items.name: Krosmozaur

items.description: [!] Cette ceinture à base de racines d'abraknyde et de feuilles de branche soignante est une version revisitée et stylisée de l'illustre ceinture luthe.
items.name: [!] Ceinture Sadida

items.description: [!] Ces ailes ne vous seront pas utiles pour voler, mais vous pourrez prendre à la volée un de ses os pour vous armer et mieux piller.
items.name: [!] Ailes osseuses Sram

items.description: [!] Avec ce costume, vous excellerez dans l'art de donner la patte.
items.name: [!] Attributs Ouginak

items.description: [!] On dit que la taille des ailes d'un Eliotrope reflète son niveau de maîtrise du Wakfu.
items.name: [!] Ailes Eliotrope

items.description: [!] Krozti, et le dragon sera en vous.
items.name: [!] Krozti

items.description: [!] Ce petit dragon va devenir votre phare au milieu de la nuit, votre lumière au bout du tunnel ! Un guide précieux empli de sagesse... qu'il ne faut pas non plus suivre tête baissée ! En effet, Dardikil est du genre blagueur, puisqu'il ne prend rien, mais alors rien au sérieux...
items.name: [!] Dardikil

items.description: [!] Vous n'êtes pas du genre à prendre des vessies pour des lanternes, mais vous croyez fermement que ce bouclier rutilant peut vous aider à décrocher la lune. Devenez le phare de votre guilde : à votre tour, éclairez la lanterne de vos coéquipiers !
items.name: [!] Égide de Sagesse

items.description: [!] L'aura brumeuse de cette cape semble faire de vous un être tout-puissant qui, réchappé des limbes, reviendrait avec toutes les connaissances du Krosmoz en héritage... Ou alors vous sortez simplement d'un frigo ou d'une chambre froide. Sans trembler. Ce qui est un peu impressionnant aussi.
items.name: [!] Manteau de Lumière

items.description: [!] Si ce n'était pas le cas jusque-là, cette coiffe vous permettra d'avoir la lumière à tous les étages et de devenir plus clairvoyant. Vos décisions seront plus sages. Votre regard sur le monde, plus distancé. Vous serez le/la premier(e) à profiter de vos lumières !
items.name: [!] Heaume de l'Aube

items.description: The distant sound of a megaphone snaps you out of your daze. Only a moment had gone by, but it seemed to last 10 long years. You feel overcome by sweet melancholy and an almost-euphoric trance – the kind you feel when something important comes to an end. It's as if everything you'd put in was returned to you a hundredfold. So that's the power of Zi, then...
items.name: Zi Shield
